kuramon.description: Kuramon is an Unidentified Digimon that suddenly appeared on a computer network. A single Digi-Egg was born from the malice of humans abusing computers and the aggression from conflicts unfolding over networks. The Digi-Egg was the amalgamation of humanity's destructive instincts, and the mysterious Digimon born from it is incredibly dangerous. It multiplies within a computer network like a virus, causing minor network failures. Kuramon uses its special move Glare Eye to produce a frothy substance from its giant eye.

choromon.description: A super-small Machine Digimon with red eyes that act as photosensors. Choromon's constant restless movements make it seem very cute, but they're just because of its simple programming making it react to bright light. In dark places, it can't move at all. For reasons unknown, it discharges electricity from the tip of its tail when it's in a good mood. It uses its move Jamming Powder to emit metal particles and temporarily confuse its enemy's AI. It then takes advantage of this temporary confusion to flee.

dodomon.description: A Slime Digimon covered entirely in a tough material called Mithril Hair. Dodomon exhibits an aggressive nature right from birth, and even though its fangs haven't grown in yet, it likes to threaten foes by opening wide and pretending to bite them. Because of this behavior, these Digimon are often taken out by others, making Dodomon quite rare. When an enemy approaches, Dodomon attacks by shooting Little Iron Beads from its mouth.

pabumon.description: This Slime Digimon looks like a mere bit of sea-green froth at first glance, but it's actually a totally autonomous creature with a plethora of expressions. Pabumon's delicate surface means it has practically no defense or prowess in combat. It creates infinite tiny foam clones from the pacifier-like object in its mouth. This ability was originally used to develop computer viruses, but Pabumon's lack of life force made for poor implementation. Life is fleeting for this adorable Digimon baby. It uses Adhesive Bubble Blow to release bubbles from its body to bind enemies, giving Pabumon a chance to escape.

punimon.description: A brand new type of Digimon. Three feelers grow from the top of its gelatinous, red body. Punimon is incapable of fighting, instead relying on Acid Bubbles to threaten enemies.

botamon.description: A newborn Digital Monster. Dark peach fuzz covers the surface of Botamon's slimy body. This new addition to the Digital World can't fight, but it can spout Acid Bubbles from its mouth to intimidate foes.

poyomon.description: This Digimon baby uses its translucent body to float along the Net Ocean like a jellyfish. Possessing the most primitive structural makeup of any Digimon discovered to date, it garners attention from Digital World anthropologists and Digimon fanatics alike. They hail it as a "missing link," potentially capable of unlocking the mystery behind Digimon generation. To protect itself from foes, Poyomon shoots Acid Bubbles from its mouth.

Kapurimon has bat-like traits, emitting ultrasonic waves from its mouth and recognizing objects ahead of it from the rebounding waves, instead of relying on its weak eyesight. This allows it to remain active no matter what time of day or night it is. Kapurimon uses its special move Howling Hertz to make its two horns resonate. Anyone hit by this attack has their hearing paralyzed, even large Digimon.

Tanemon Digivolved from a Yuramon that landed on the ground after drifting through the air in search of the perfect environment. Extremely skittish, it will use its four legs to quickly dig a hole so it can hide its body at the first sign of a threat. While Tanemon's body is hidden underground, the seedling on its head makes it indistinguishable from a plant, protecting it from harm. That being said, this tactic proves ineffective against herbivorous Digimon.

Tsumemon corrodes data at frightening speed, causing networks to malfunction. Its movement speed is just as fast, making this Digimon difficult to catch once it's Digivolved to this level. These limbs, which are highly unusual on an In-Training Digimon, give Tokomon a unique and extremely cute look. However, that cuteness can be deceptive, and anyone who reaches out to pet Tokomon may be in for a surprise as it quickly opens its mouth and bites down with its rows of sharp teeth. Tokomon has an innocent personality, though, and doesn't mean any real harm.

Approaching it is dangerous, as it will charge in recklessly for a tackle. Dorimon's pointed ears are tough, acting as horns and inflicting a modicum of damage when it tackles. That being said, it can't turn once it has gained enough speed. Dorimon's special move is Metal Drop, spitting metal beads as it charges toward the enemy.

Pagumon can use these ears deftly like hands, often pulling down its enemy's eyelids or slapping their rear with them mockingly. Particularly mean-spirited, it can often be seen teasing the likes of Koromon or Tsunomon, chasing them around and around. Pagumon may even spit Poison Bubbles from its mouth to bully other Digimon.

Yokomon moves by deftly manipulating its root-like tentacles, and is able to float softly through the air, albeit for short distances. Its skin still isn't fit for the high pressure and low temperature of ocean depths, so it can only spend limited amounts of time submerged in the deep.

motimon.description: A soft-bodied Digimon with highly elastic skin, Motimon uses the protrusions beneath its body to waggle its way around. The name "Motimon" comes from its resemblance to a mochi rice cake when it puffs up its body in excitement. Despite its appearance, Motimon possesses a surprisingly high degree of intelligence, and so is believed to have developed from a computer's dictionary feature. Capable of understanding human language, Motimon can occasionally be seen altering the shape of its body in an effort at communication. Motimon uses its mochi-like Elastic Bubbles to restrict opponents' movement.

Since it hasn't fully matured, it still lacks strength, but its fierce disposition makes it reckless. Hard, sharp claws grow from its hands and feet, and it makes full use of them in battle. Agumon shows much potential, promising Digivolution into a great and powerful Digimon. Its special move is Pepper Breath, spitting flames at its foes.

Kudamon is constantly building up holy power within the earring on its left ear, and the amount it accumulates affects the course of its next Digivolution. Calm and collected by nature, it can assess any situation—even combat —with accuracy, ensuring the advantage in battle. If things ever go south, though, Kudamon enters its cartridge to strengthen its defensive position. Its special move Blinding Ray dazzles the enemy with a glaring flash emitted from its earring.

A busybody and a troublemaker, Gomamon loves to get involved in every situation. The streak of red fur running from its head down its back moves in accordance with its mood, bristling when Gomamon is angry. Its claws are sharp enough to cut through solid ice with ease, and anyone who underestimates Gomamon is in for a rude awakening. Its special move is Marching Fishes, with which Gomamon commands a loyal squad of small fish to attack.

The fabled Legend-Arms are said to be capable of either saving the world in the hands of an angel, or destroying it in the hands of a devil. Zubamon possesses the data of the Twentiest, and often shouts "I am the Twentiest!" without knowing what that means. It dislikes anything warped or twisted, and is in constant pursuit of its ideal of sharpness. In battle and in jest, it's always trying to look sharp, and days when it succeeds put it in a good mood. Though it has its Twenty Dive attack that involves rushing headlong at an enemy, Zubamon's true strength lies in its weapon form.

Because its DigiCore generates heat, its body is hot enough to cause burns. Solarmon uses its special move Shiny Ring to throw heat-emitting gears that scorch the enemy.

While Terriermon's composition is enough to deem it a Beast Digimon, the form it takes after Digivolving is still unknown. Rumor has it that it's sometimes born with a twin. Terriermon's extreme cuteness and calm behavior don't give the impression that this Digimon is of the Combat Species. Still, the power it exhibits in battle belies its appearance. It uses its signature move Terrier Tornado to spin both of its ears like a propeller, creating a small tornado.

tentomon.description: The prototypical Insectoid Digimon, Tentomon has a hard carapace but a low level of aggression. Tentomon has one claw on each of its forelegs, and four claws on its middle and hind legs. Its middle legs in particular are highly dexterous, similar to human hands. Though other Insectoid Digimon of Tentomon's Digivolution level are consumed by a strong fighting spirit, Tentomon retains a love and appreciation for nature at this stage. Exhibiting a fondness for relaxation, Tentomon stops to smell flowers and nap in the shade of trees. Even so, it does have the special move Super Shocker, which involves using its wings to shoot out amplified bolts of static electricity.

Unlike the bold and fearless Agumon, ToyAgumon has a skittish side, and its blocks fly apart when it's startled. Despite this, it has a strong sense of justice that won't allow for any sort of wrongdoing. It also adores children, and loves to spend time interacting with them on the Net. Its special move is Plastic Blaze, with which it shoots out a toy missile shaped like a flame. It's surprisingly powerful.

tapirmon.description: A Digimon that resembles a "baku," a being in Japanese folklore that eats dreams. Believed to have been born from a medical computer that monitors brainwaves, Tapirmon seems to feed on human REM sleep data. In the latest round of research, it was also found to possess the ability to erase nightmares and computer viruses. Since it can also return those nightmares and viruses to a benign state, it's believed to be a Holy Digimon. The Holy Ring it wears on one of its forelegs seems likely related to both its special abilities and Holy nature. Tapirmon's special move is Nightmare Syndrome, which releases all of the nightmares it absorbed at once to terrify its adversaries. This is the same special move as that of the Perfect Digimon, Digitamamon, but how the two might be related remains a mystery.

The next Digivolution of Hyokomon will only happen when it breaks out of its shell through endless sword training. Its special move is Downward Cleave, utilizing its wings and leg strength to jump up and swing its sword straight down to split its foe in two.

It spends most of its time on the ground, but can escape into the air when danger draws near. Since it's similar in flying ability to Patamon, Biyomon sees Patamon as a rival. Biyomon's dream is to one day Digivolve into Birdramon and fly freely through the sky. Its nightmare is becoming Kokatorimon, who can't fly at all. Possessed of an inquisitive mind, it likes to peck at the sprout growing from Tanemon's head. Biyomon's special move is Spiral Twister, an attack of spectral flames.

Since it's still a child, it isn't able to make full use of its holy powers, and has yet to realize its destiny. As a result, its nature is fundamentally unstable, and it's capable of becoming either good or evil. There will likely come a day, however, when Salamon will awaken to its destiny as one of the Virus Busters. After all, it was born a sacred Digimon. Salamon is also an experimental Digimon created by Digimon researchers, and since it was modeled after a human pet, it looks a great deal like a real animal. Its special move Puppy Howl involves letting out a supersonic screech that can paralyze foes.

Once a battle starts, it continues to fight no matter how many hits it takes, making for a reliable ally. The ability for melee fighting it possesses is so strong that it needs to wrap its fists with leather belts so it won't injure itself with the destructive power of its punches. With its special move Bear Fist, Bearmon leaps at its opponent's chest to drive home a full-force blow.

It does quite well with humans, conversely, and will happily waddle along behind them. Penmon's wings have degenerated, so it can't fly or walk very quickly. But when it slides across the ice on its belly, it can reach speeds close to 40 mph. When in the water, Penmon can use its small wings to skillfully swim around. Its special move is Super Slap, where it sneaks up on the enemy to smack their cheeks as hard as it can with both arms.

It's often found in the middle of most Digital World brawls, causing even the likes of Ogremon to get fed up with its persistence. Ryudamon is covered in Japanese-style armor that boasts high defense, yet its movements are quite nimble, allowing it to jump in and fight at brazenly close range. The more it fights, the more it cultivates combat prowess. Ryudamon possesses gallantry, a samurai spirit and a soul that renders it unafraid of powerful enemy Digimon. The data hidden within the deepest part of its DigiCore during the experiment contains such fierce combat data as warlords and dragons from Japanese mythology, and Ryudamon is thought to possess the potential to grow into a mighty Digimon. Its special move is Iai Blade, with which it leaps up to the opponent to fire an iron blade from its mouth at point-blank range.

Despite having the appearance of a child, Lucemon is wiser and more powerful than an Ultimate Digimon. It's said that in the modern era, Lucemon's abilities have been passed down to and divided among the Three Celestials Lucemon's special move is Grand Cross, which fires a collection of ten super-heated spheres of light arranged into the shape of a cross as if they were planets in alignment. Crabmon attacks with the giant blades on its left pincer and the powerful grip of its right pincer. For defense, it relies on its spiny shell to damage attackers, and is utterly self-confident in battle. Crabmon is fully aware of the weak points of its joints and underbelly, and thus rarely leaves them exposed. It enjoys trapping its opponents, and is something of a prankster. Crabmon's special move is Scissors Execution, which launches its sharp left pincer right for its adversary's throat.

No insect Machine Digimon had been discovered up to that point, and so Kokuwamon's existence wasn't even considered a possibility. Its stun gun-shaped head and arms can discharge 100 megavolts of electricity when it senses danger, so none can approach without caution. Even so, Kokuwamon lacks any aggression, sporting instead an accommodating nature that seeks peace. Kokuwamon obtains nourishment from electricity, and recharges itself with the two limbs on its midsection. Its special move is Mini Scissor Claw, which electrifies its pincers to slice through even the sturdiest of objects.

It also has a selfish side, and can be a real handful when angered, rampaging like an erupting volcano. The ore data Gotsumon uses for its armor differs depending on where and how it was generated, giving Gotsumon the potential to Digivolve into a number of different forms. A special function in Shoutmon's throat converts passion into energy, unleashing a Soul Crusher attack that uses a mic to amplify the burning passion in its chest and strike the enemy. Because passion is the source of its strength, Shoutmon won't abandon a battle no matter how much damage it receives, contributing to its savage reputation.

It possesses physical capabilities difficult to even imagine given its small size, with its speed and power ranking among the very best of all Rookie Digimon. Though extremely fierce by nature, it also has a softer side it only shows to those it deems worthy of its trust. Despite having wings, they're not fully developed, so Dracomon is unable to fly. One of its other defining characteristics is its drive to collect "shiny things," and it has an odd attachment to gems and certain types of metal. If it's particularly fond of some shiny object, it will eat it. Its special moves include Baby Breath, which it uses to breathe out a blast of hot air.

The personality characteristic of the Combat Species is particularly apparent in Dorumon. It has a strong instinct for battle, biting and roaring at anything and everything, though it apparently feels a sense of attachment to something after biting it. The strong life force data of the legendary "dragon" was found to have been hidden in the deepest part of its DigiCore during an experiment, and Dorumon apparently has the potential to grow into a mighty Digimon. Dorumon's special move is Metal Cannon, which fires an iron ball from its mouth.

Patamon can use these to fly, but since it can only do so at a little over 0.5 mph, its its walking speed is said to be considerably faster. Even so, watching it struggle to fly is an endearing sight, making it very popular (although Patamon itself doesn't appreciate such sentiment). Patamon is extremely obedient and very good about doing what it's told. It can also use its hidden holy power without a Holy Ring—a sign that it's descended from an Ancient species of Digimon. Patamon's special move is Air Shot, taking a deep breath and then releasing a powerful blast of air.

Huckmon's lineage gives it a keen sense for battle, and training supervised by the Sistermon siblings makes it more than evenly matched in fights against even Ultimate foes. Huckmon specializes in nimble melee combat, using Fifth Rush to cleave the opponent with its tough claws. It pursues its dream to become a Royal Knight like Gankoomon.

Though it Digivolved from Tanemon in a reptilian fashion, it's a rare type of Digimon classified as a Vegetation Digimon based on its appearance and characteristics. During the day, Palmon opens its flower and leaf-like appendages to enable photosynthesis. Its root-like feet are usually buried in the ground absorbing nutrients, but it can also use them to walk. The flower on Palmon's head gives off a sweet scent when it's happy or enjoying itself and a foul stench when it's angry or feels threatened. The latter is so bad it can send even larger Digimon running. Palmon's special move is Poison Ivy, with which it entangles its foe in highly poisonous vines. Anything hit by this attack is paralyzed.

When no predators are around, or when in a good mood, it will spread open the petals on its head and arms. Floramon sees Palmon as a rival, and has a very high opinion of itself. Its special move is Rain of Pollen, which releases clouds of allergy-inducing pollen from the flowers on its arms. Anyone hit by this attack—even a large Digimon—will be robbed of both their composure and will to fight.

Terriermon has a laid-back personality, albeit with a lot of energy, while Lopmon has the opposite disposition, being more of a lonely crybaby. Unlike other Rookies, this Digimon's future Digivolution seems quite promising, but it's extremely prone to mutation, so caution is warranted when raising it. Exceedingly weak on its own, Wormmon stands little chance against larger Digimon. But with the power of the Digi-Eggs, it can Armor Digivolve and display incredible power. Like a larva maturing into an adult, Wormmon will one day Digivolve into a Champion of great might. This Digimon is the very embodiment of future potential. It uses its special move Sticky Net to shoot viscous webs that bind the enemy.

Keramon is capable of consuming more than 100 megabytes per second, and most data is destroyed the instant Keramon accesses it. Extremely playful by nature, it thinks of its destructive acts as a kind of game. Its special move is Crazy Giggle, with which it unleashes a highly destructive beam of light from its mouth as it laughs—if you can call it laughing.

aegiomon.description: A Deity Digimon with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a mountain goat. Aegiomon is usually affiliated with the same musical troupe as Sirenmon, reveling in the music by playing the Syrinx flute hanging from his waist. He loves peace, and although he dislikes fighting, an unknown quantity of power dwells within him, and he demonstrates exceptional combat prowess when fighting to protect something he cares about. Aegiomon plays Attract Echo on his Syrinx to draw the listener's attention, stealing its sense of self and making it unable to see anything but Aegiomon as it remains fixated on the tune. This gives other Digimon the chance to escape or pursue said listener. Aegiomon's special move is Stun Beat Blow, which strikes the opponent and discharges the electricity in Aegiomon's body through his arms, numbing the enemy's nerves and rendering it unable to move.

The sharp horn growing from its head is made of Mithril, a rare metal, and the skin beneath its pelt is just as hard. Ikkakumon's clawed limbs are capable of emitting blistering heat at will. As a result, Ikkakumon can always maintain a firm foothold when walking on ice, even if unable to move quickly. In combat, Ikkakumon will threaten opponents with a bold roar, much like a lion's. Its special move is Harpoon Torpedo, with which it fires the horn on its head at the enemy, as the horn can be regrown.

It specializes in aerial combat, invoking storms with its roar and creating colossal whirlwinds by flapping its wings. Though quite vicious by nature, Airdramon is also very intelligent. Nevertheless, any average Tamer would find it nearly impossible to control. Airdramon beats its huge wings to unleash a cutting vacuum blade with its special move Spinning Needle.

Angemon remains utterly composed in the face of evil, attacking relentlessly until its foe is annihilated. Legend has it that Angemon has often descended at the head of a host of other Digimon of the same species when the Digital World was in crisis. It's also said that Devimon, who was lured to the Dark Side, was originally of the same species. Angemon's special move is Heaven's Knuckle, with which it pummels its foe with a shining fist of gold.

Though it's unclear how it came to be an Insectoid type, it's understood to have the power of an ant and the defense system of a beetle. As you would expect from an insect, it only thinks about survival, and has no other intelligence whatsoever. Hostile toward Virus Digimon, Kabuterimon attacks on sight without mercy. Its head is made of metal, granting it impregnable defense. Its special move is Electro Shocker.

Faster than its appearance suggests, Gargomon brings down its foes with unparalleled accuracy and precision. Its powerful legs let it jump high into the air, at which point it spreads its ears to glide. Cheerful by nature, Gargomon may lose control once angered. It's obsessed with its beloved "D-VI'S 503xx" jeans. It uses its special move Dumdum Uppercut to get close to the enemy and thrust up from below with its Gatling Arm.

garurumon.description: A wolf-like Beast Digimon with a pale silver pelt. Garurumon's fur is said to be as hard as the legendary rare metal Mithril, and the blades extending from its shoulders are sharp enough to slice through anything they touch. Possessed of a physique honed in the frozen tundra and a fierce instinct for conflict, Garurumon is feared by other Digimon for its predatory agility and unerring accuracy in bringing down its prey. However, it's also incredibly intelligent and steadfastly loyal to any it acknowledges as its leader. Garurumon uses its special move Fox Fire to breathe out a stream of intense blue flames.

ginryumon.description: A Beast Dragon Digimon with sturdy Japanese-style armor covering its whole body. Ginryumon is lighter than it appears, drifting gracefully through the air and fighting while parrying enemy attacks with its smooth and extremely tough armor. It has the courage to fend off enemy attacks with its own body, and the insight to accurately perceive said attacks right before they land. Ginryumon specializes in attacks with outstanding penetrative ability, and is unflinching in the face of any enemy Digimon. Because of the antiquated interface on its forehead, this Digimon is presumed to be the Digivolution of an experimental "Prototype Digimon." Ginryumon's special move is Metal Armor Blade, which impales its foe with an iron lance launched from its mouth.

grizzlymon.description: Grizzlymon is a Beast Digimon that might seem ferocious thanks to its large frame, not to mention its deadly claws and fangs, but it has the honest and straightforward spirit of a true martial artist. It has the combat sense to match, too, relying not only on attacks but moving with a speed that belies its great bulk to avoid and deflect enemy strikes as well. Grizzlymon never starts a fight, but when angered it will draw itself up onto its hind legs and lash out with its heavyweight bear claws, "Kumazume." Grizzlymon's strength is such that just with this one strike it can critically injure most Digimon. Apparently, WaruMonzaemon wears its Bear Claw in imitation of this attack. Grizzlymon's greatest special move, Maul Attack, turns the force of an enemy's move against it, striking where it's vulnerable to defeat it in a single blow.

Its special move is Blue Flare Breath, with which it breathes out scorching blue flames. Blue Flare Breath breaks down a foe's surface texture data, leaving the DigiCore of a Digimon hit by this move exposed and open to attack.

While Strikedramon still has many vestiges of Monodramon, such as the horn jutting out of the back of its head, it has so transformed its appearance into a Commando-Mode Digimon covered in metal plating that it now resembles a completely different species. Despite being an inherently kindhearted Digimon, should it happen upon a Virus-attribute type, Strikedramon becomes consumed by an instinct to exterminate and doesn't stop fighting until its opponent's data has been reduced to dust. It uses its special move Fang Strike to heat its metal plating to red-hot levels, turning itself into a mass of flame and tackling the opponent in a fearsome maneuver.

It has no eyes, but the red feelers on its head act as sensors to accurately track the target's position. Snimon's special move is Shadow Sickle, which unleashes a supersonic slash invisible to the naked eye.

Its new form perfectly embodies that spirit, and ZubaEagermon is committed to constantly forging ahead, over good terrain and bad, even if it's reduced to a crawl. Its special move is Vantheon, with which it curls up into a ball and spins, slicing through enemies with the blade on its tail. In its sword form, which it's quite proud of, it cuts its way through any foe with all of its strength.

Birdramon's special move is Meteor Wing, flapping its wings to send feathers shooting down like meteors.

Other than the V-shaped mark on its chest, for which it's named, not much is known about Veedramon or its surrounding ecosystem. It's sometimes mistaken for a dog for some reason. It has extraordinary attacking power for a Champion Digimon, exhibiting strength even outstripping that of an Ultimate when the chips are down. It uses its special move V-Nova Blast to shoot out a high-temperature heat ray from its mouth.

Mojyamon is a gentle creature that never shows any hostility, but even so, it treats its den and territory as sacred grounds, and doesn't forgive any who invade its holy land. Frigimon itself hates the idea of fighting, and is ill-suited to other Digimon who enjoy combat—Meramon in particular. It unleashes its special move Sub-zero Ice Punch from its sizable frame.

Nevertheless, it still possesses exceptional explosive power and flight capabilities, largely due to the feral Digimon it used to be prior to remodeling. Though small, Raptordramon is capable of taking down even ultra-large Digimon in a single blow if it can gradually unlock its abilities. It also loves gambling—especially Russian roulette—and its fairness is beyond reproach, allowing even Virus Digimon to get away if they win at this game. It has a rival in the "Digimon Hunter" Ogremon, which devotes itself entirely to acts of destruction. Leomon hones its formidable physique with daily training so that it can withstand all attacks, and it kills foes with its ultimate technique, the special move Fist of the Beast King. It strengthens and grows its arm larger in order to defeat Leomon, and hunts for a chance at retribution. Shedding its pride as a warrior, Cyclonemon is now a maddened combatant who thinks only of slaughter, all for the sake of revenge. Its special move is Hyper Heat, which melts any and all things.

Digimon who have their blood sucked by Sangloupmon have all the data drained from their DigiCores, causing them to perish, as they can no longer maintain vital functions. Sangloupmon is capable of teleporting to other locations instantly by disassembling its own data into packets and sending them across the Net. Its special move is Sticker Blade, which fires off a spray of thousands of minute blades to skewer opponents in the blink of an eye.

It loves dark places, and being a pile of scrap data, it's just as disliked by other Digimon as Numemon. Sukamon's intelligence and attack power are both nonexistent. Its small rodent partner Chuumon can't fight, but is as crafty as they come, and always entices Sukamon into doing wicked deeds.

Tuskmon's foolhardy personality means it will charge at and destroy every obstacle in its path, earning it the nickname of the "Panzer Digimon." Specializing in charging tackles, Tuskmon has made countless Digimon fall before its attacks. The stars on its arms represent the number of Digimon that Tuskmon has defeated (one hundred per star). If its horns break, it can shed them like shark teeth and bring new horns from the back to the front, making any attempt to destroy its horns fruitless. Devimon was once a radiant Digimon of the Angemon species, but it became a Dark Angel when it fell into the distorted space of the Digital World known as the Dark Area. The prominent Mark of Evil on its chest is proof of this. Though it has a cunning and malevolent personality, Devimon is also extremely intelligent. It's said that any who stare into its glowing, red eyes fall victim to its mind control and become subject to its whims. Devimon's special move is Death Claw, which uses its two extendable arms to pierce its opponent.

Each existed as a separate Digimon, but a computer ran amok after getting hit by a powerful electromagnetic storm, bugging out and fusing them together into Deltamon. A Digimon with three heads and two tails, it specializes in three-stage attacks utilizing these physical features, making it capable of taking on three Digimon at once. Still, each part of it was once a fiendish Digimon, so while they share a mindset for destruction, they have no spirit of cooperation, and are usually on bad terms. Deltamon uses its special move Triple Forces to unleash energy from all three mouths in a single blast.

Even though a spider-species type, Dokugumon was originally a gentle and quiet Insectoid Digimon. One day, however, it was caught in a powerful electromagnetic storm, and was infected with a computer virus that had been lurking around the Net. From that moment on, it became one big lump of venom—in other words, a nasty computer virus, corroding everything it touched. Dokugumon's eight-legged mobility is worthy of special mention, too. Even if the enemy runs from it at full speed, this Digimon will be right on its heels, pursuing it until it tires itself out. And then, as soon as it stops to take a rest, Dokugumon uses Venom Blast on it, unleashing a dreadful, venomous attack from its fiendish fangs.

It loves alcohol and violence, but once it invaded this Digital World (the details of which are still fuzzy), it Digivolved into an active creature. Inspired by the survival-of-the-fittest nature of the Digital World, it threw itself into battle. Its true power remains unknown. That being said, Nanimon has made it through many battles and evolved into its supreme form.

Its body is protected by a tough carapace, and it pinches foes with its huge talons before killing them with the extra-potent venomous stinger on its tail. The Digivolution process of Insectoid Digimon is still unknown, but from its face, some have surmised that Flymon originally Digivolved from a Kunemon-type creature. Its special move is Brown Stingers, which shoots a stinger from its tail that completely paralyzes the Digimon it pierces, turning it purple before ending its life. Numerous battles with other Digimon have rendered Musyamon's appearance into that of a pathetic battlefield deserter, but that's only proof of its fearsome battle prowess and vitality. A savage warrior that's survived endless battles—that's Musyamon in a nutshell. The demon sword Shiratori-maru in its right hand is engraved with a forbidden spell that absorbs the life force of those it cuts, and is said to only grow sharper with every thousand Digimon it slashes down. Musyamon also has a special move called Kirisute Gomen that it unleashes from its Shiratori-maru. One day, it will settle things with Leomon, crossing its beloved blade with Leomon's.

Given its Virus attribute, the Digimon controlling it can also be considered a Virus Digimon. Mekanorimon is still in development, meaning its DigiCore will overheat if it's used too much. This crumbling form affords neither attack power nor intelligence, making Raremon act according to instinct alone. Agunimon's DigiCore is covered in the holy blaze of the Spiritual Fire, allowing it to control fire at will. A guardian deity, it's an avatar of the Firewall that defends the Net. Agunimon gets riled up easily, so its warrior side uses yoga breathing to encourage mental discipline. Agunimon also has a somewhat old-fashioned way of speaking, akin to that of a martial artist. It fights with Eastern martial arts in battle, focusing its spirit to a point to gather flames in one place and raise its attack power. Agunimon uses its special move Pyro Punch to shoot a flame dragon from its fire-wreathed fist.

lobomon.description: A Digimon with power over light that bears the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. The lavender parts all over Lobomon's body are made of Saint Amethyst, a crystal containing holy light. This light maintains an extraordinary durability in the amethyst when one's heart is true, but the substance turns brittle the moment negativity arises in the heart of any who wield it. Lobomon has a chivalrous spirit and puts its life on the line for what it believes in, and hates injustice. Taciturn and rarely concerning itself with others, many believe it to be an unfeeling creature, but this warrior is actually kind-hearted. Lobomon uses its special move Zwei Sieger to connect the twin swords Licht Schwert before cutting multiple opponents to pieces.

lanamon.description: A Digimon with power over water, it bears the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Lanamon has a sharp intuition and an changeable mood, due perhaps to the fact that it used to operate mainly in the ocean area of a weather forecasting system. Its emotions are tempestuous, acting like a lovely young lady when in a good mood, and crying like a hysterical baby when it gets upset. Lanamon uses few direct attacks in battle, relying instead on manipulated rain or other indirect methods of fighting. That being said, its battle strength swells during surges of emotion, with its combat prowess growing unfathomably strong when crying. Lanamon's special move is Rain Stream, which focuses torrential rain to crush the enemy.

burninggreymon.description: A Digimon with power over fire that bears the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. BurningGreymon's skin withstands high temperatures, allowing it to move even through lava. This firefighter snuffs out fires with its own instantaneous, explosive flames. Said to have sprung forth from research data on active volcanoes, it's thought to contain an unknown, immeasurable energy. The fire dragon of Hindu mythology, adversary to the thunder god Indra, is embodied in BurningGreymon's ferocious personality. BurningGreymon uses its special move Corona Blaster to fire a laser rivaling solar heat rays from the Rudriya Darpana superweapons on its arms.

calmaramon.description: A Digimon with power over water, it bears the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Half humanoid and half beast, Calmaramon can spin its tentacles at high speed for offense, or gather them together into a defensive wall, making for a versatile tool in combat. If it can't finish an opponent with its tentacles, Calmaramon withdraws into its mantle, increasing the power of its attacks as it takes on the form of a giant squid. This mantle is even more resilient than its tentacles, rendering external physical attacks against it harmless. Though Calmaramon is more accustomed to the seas and skies, it can skillfully maneuver its ten tentacles to move around on land like a giant hermit crab as well. Much like a witch, it's crafty and quick to anger. Its special move is Titanic Charge, which spins its hardened mantle to drill into foes.

kendogarurumon.description: A Digimon with power over light that bears the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. KendoGarurumon's capability of moving at incredible speed is perhaps related to its discovery of a fiber optic network. Capable of dodging between bullets to close in on foes, it will mercilessly tear apart anyone it deems evil with its sharp claws and fangs. Possessed of a righteous heart and all the determination of Garmr, the wolf said to have fought with Týr in Norse mythology, KendoGarurumon has an intense hatred of evil. It will refuse to obey any with even a hint of wickedness in their heart, although once it swears loyalty to someone, it will never betray them. Its special move is Speed Star, with which it charges forward at light speed to cut through foes with the Wing Blades on its back.

aegiochusmon.description: A Deity Digimon that synthesizes the abilities of various species, using a human body as its base. This synthesis is said to have resulted from the pursuit of the ultimate goal of omnipotence, dramatically changing this Digimon's form to match its environment. This form is based on Dragon-species data, which would ordinarily lie dormant within its body, centered around the crystal in its chest, but Aegiochusmon manifested this data onto the surface of its body, establishing it as armor. This armor is a power suit that's not only for defense, but which also acts as muscle, dramatically increasing attack power. Aegiochusmon uses its special move Bolt Break Knockdown to perform a punch rush with fists coiled in lightning produced from its horn, or Lightning Pile to drive a pile-shaped bolt down on the enemy from above, driving them into the ground. If this move pierces the enemy once, subsequently released piles then connect without fail, no matter where they're thrown.

Due to its Plant-type base, its body is dramatically lighter than other forms. Aegiochusmon: Green is capable of firing sturdy thorns from the busters equipped to both arms. It uses these for offense, defense and tricky maneuvers that utilize them like grapples on various surfaces. This form is best known for its agile movements that utilize its equipment and airy frame. Approximately 1.5 times the size of Kabuterimon, MegaKabuterimon is quite large for an Insectoid Digimon. It has dramatically increased the power of its horn, which is the species' primary weapon, as well as grown muscles at the bases of its forelimbs, improving its hand-to-hand combat ability. MegaKabuterimon is renowned for its chivalrous nature, and is well-known for protecting weaker creatures. Its special move is Horn Buster, by which MegaKabuterimon stabs opponents with its giant horn.

andromon.description: Andromon is an Android Digimon with a humanoid shape. It's powerful enough to take out any Digimon of less than Ultimate level with a single blow. Developed as a prototype for Android Digimon, Andromon was created as a machine-based model at the same time Boltmon was made to be an organic one. The same techniques were then appropriated for use in other Digimon, including MetalGreymon and Megadramon. Since Andromon is a prototype, it lacks emotions and has no will of its own, acting only in accordance with its programming. It uses its special move Spiral Sword to fire an energy blade from its arm.

It's believed to be capable of flying at speeds exceeding Mach 20, meaning very few Digimon could likely survive an aerial battle with Wingdramon. Wingdramon's special move is Blaze Sonic Breath, with which it breathes out a blast of scorching hot air faster than the speed of sound.

It also gained more than wings in the process of Digivolving, and now boasts increased offensive and defensive capabilities. Whatever the explanation, this stuffed Tyrannomon has all the offensive and defensive power of Monzaemon, meaning no ordinary Digimon can stand up to it. Champion-level Angels tend to have six wings, while Ultimate-level Angels have eight wings. Angewomon is calm by nature, but doesn't tolerate wickedness, and will continue to attack until its foes are reformed. Due to its strength of spirit and great power, it's regarded as a goddess-like figure of the Digital World. Even among Bird Digimon, Garudamon is worshiped as a Digimon that only a select, highly-intelligent, combat-adept few can Digivolve into. Whenever the Digital World is in chaos, Garudamon is said to appear, resolving the source of the disorder and guiding things back to a more peaceful course. Garudamon is also close friends with the hero Leomon, who possesses the same spirit. Garudamon's special move is Shadow Wing, with which it sends forth a vacuum blade at incredible speed to slice opponents to shreds.

By spinning the turbines on its arms and legs at high speeds, GrapLeomon is able to unleash a wide variety of techniques. To keep them spinning, though, it must channel its fighting spirit directly from its DigiCore into them all at once, which requires exceptional force of will. It's only because GrapLeomon has inherited the data of Leomon, the "King of Beasts," that it's able to spin its turbines at such incredible speeds, using a sheer, singlehearted devotion to justice. Though not as powerful overall, Grademon's swordsmanship is believed to surpass that of LordKnightmon of the Royal Knights. The royal blue cape Grademon wears is also a badge of honor bestowed for its meritorious deeds in many battles. Its special move is Cross Blade, a swift sword technique that cleaves through the enemy in a cross-shaped pattern.

greatgrizzlymon.description: The self-proclaimed strongest hand-to-hand fighter in the Digital World, GreatGrizzlymon lives to entertain those who watch its battles. Its performance in battle captivates onlooking Digimon and enlivens the battlefield. It's a hard worker that never neglects its training so that it can live up to the audience's expectations. Any fight with PileVolcanomon, its eternal rival, is a big event that draws in large crowds. Its special move is Spirited Claws, by it which slashes its foes with its fiery claws.

cerberusmon.description: A Dark Beast Digimon known as the "Watchdog of Hell." The claws on Cerberusmon's limbs are tough enough to easily slice through low-purity Chrondigizoid. Its body is also protected by a hard organic shell, and has the ability to heal any damage instantly. The pieces of armor on each shoulder possess wills of their own, and are able to instantly sense attacks coming from any direction and report this to Cerberusmon. It emits incandescent flames with its special move Mad Dog Fire.

cerberusmon-wm.description: Cerberusmon: Werewolf Mode is a mutant form of Cerberusmon, the Digimon known as the "Watchdog of Hell" that lives in the Dark Area. It transformed into its current form to prevent the spread of data created from human malice that permeates the Internet in the form of both images and text, because it fears this data will have an adverse effect on the Digital World overall. As a result of its transformation, its data was rewritten so that its shell-covered body can now walk on two legs and its arms can chew up any tainted data it finds. With its special move Inferno Divide, it can blast foes with firebombs at point-blank range while it holds them in place in the jaws of the massive heads on the ends of its arms. It also has Mad Dog Fire, which unleashes a blast of scorching, hellish flames that reduce all things to ash. The destructive power of this attack is leaps and bounds beyond the power of the unmutated Cerberusmon's move of the same name.

cyberdramon.description: A dragon-type Android Digimon protected with special rubber armor that can resist any attack. If a Virus-attribute Digimon appears on a computer network, this Digimon will show up in an instant to eradicate it. Still, Cyberdramon operates alone, never working with the justice group known as the "Virus Busters," and its identity is wrapped in mystery. Its special rubber armor offers superior defense, but also serves to multiply its offensive strength. Its special move Desolation Claw destroys enemy configuration data with a high-frequency vibration from both arms, erasing the very space around them. Anything hit with this attack has every last iota of data eradicated.

JewelBeemon's prismatic armor changes colors depending on the viewing angle, dazzling the enemy in addition to offering protection. This melee expert prefers beautiful battles. Its special move is Spike Buster, with which it swings the spear in its right hand at the speed of light and creates shockwaves.

zudomon.description: A powerful Sea Beast Digimon Digivolved from Ikkakumon that learned to walk on two legs. Zudomon protects its tempered muscles with armor fashioned from the skins and shells of defeated foes. Similarly, Zudomon carved its own horn into a saw blade after losing the ability to regrow it. But the most powerful weapon in Zudomon's arsenal is its Thor's Hammer, made from Chrondigizoid dug up from the ancient ice. Zudomon's special move is Vulcan's Hammer, with which it blasts opponents with the powerful shockwave and flying sparks that result from swinging Thor's Hammer down.

chirinmon.description: A Holy Beast Digimon said to be an Ancient born at the advent of the Digital World, Chirinmon possesses strength akin to a Mega Digimon despite being Ultimate itself. While immensely powerful, it deeply despises conflict, and never engages in cruelty. Its compassionate personality causes it to treat all things living in the Digital World with affection, but on the other hand, doesn't hesitate to punish any who indulge in pointless violence. Using its special move Wind Cutter Sword, it swoops down in an instant to run the enemy through with the horn on its head.

duramon.description: Duramon is an Ultimate Digimon that's caught a glimpse of its final destination and begun to walk toward the other side. It may not know what its future holds, but whatever obstacles it might face, it's sure to cut through them with its own blades, tempered through repeated training. When in weapon form, the hallmark greatsword on its back demonstrates incomparable power. Its special move is Blinded, a beam attack that it fires from its chest. Should this beam hit its target, it deals a huge amount of damage and brands it with the number 20.

The claws on its feet are extremely powerful. Highly intelligent and calm, Parrotmon doesn't relish combat, but once angered, it flies out of control. Its special move Mjölnir Thunder creates an electrical current in the feathers sprouting from its head and then uses them to call down lightning on its opponent.

iceleomon.description: A proud Beast Man Digimon with a strong sense of justice. Some Leomon Digivolve into IceLeomon when, in the process of their daily training as champions of justice, their bodies become infused with the power of cold in the frozen land of the Digital World's Ice-Snow Area. IceLeomon's body and will have been tempered by the freezing cold, and it doesn't falter in the face of any attack. Its special move Fist of Ice is a punch infused with the power of cold.

hisyaryumon.description: A Beast Dragon Digimon that soars freely through the skies clad in armor of elegantly-shimmering scales. Hisyaryumon's form is the result of the interface on its forehead unlocking the data that lay dormant within its DigiCore of dragons and generals—filled with ferocious combat instincts—from Japanese myths. The orbs it clutches are the souls of its lost companions. The orb in Hisyaryumon's right hand is the soul of Kinryu, while the orb in its left hand is the soul of Kakuryu. It's said that each orb contains the data of a DigiCore hidden within it. Hisyaryumon's special move is Legendary Dragon Blade, which transforms it into a giant steel blade to slice the enemy in half with a single stroke.

In its Ultimate form, it has nearly perfected sword mastery. It possesses beautiful sword technique and the power to shatter mountains. A single Butenmon is said to be worth a thousand warriors. Its special move is Sunburst Dance, which cuts down foes in its path in a graceful motion that looks like a dance depicting the sun.

Although its impressive mane and overwhelming presence may make it seem intimidating, its strength of will makes it brave any hardship for the sake of its comrades. Its special move is Crimson Wave of the Beast King, which concentrates fierce flame and a leonine fighting spirit into its fist before unleashing a lion-shaped energy blast.

whamon.description: A gigantic Digimon that dwells in the depths of the Net Ocean. Its huge size ranks it among the largest of all Digimon in the Digital World. In fact, Whamon is so enormous that normal computers can't process the sheer volume of data that it's comprised of. Similar species have been confirmed in the waters near File Island, but Whamon, which lives along the coast of the Folder Continent, boasts attack strength and vitality superior to its kin, having Digivolved to its Ultimate form. Its special move Tidal Wave creates a massive tsunami that destroys everything in its path.

magnaangemon.description: A High Angel Digimon with eight shining, silver wings. MagnaAngemon serves as a marshal of the Digital World, supervising and surveying the many Angel Digimon within. Furthermore, it's the mouthpiece of the Essence of Light that attempts to preserve the order of the Digital World. Though MagnaAngemon usually takes the form of a priest, when the Digital World is shrouded in the Essence of Darkness, it changes into its Battle Mode to strike down evil. In this Battle Mode, MagnaAngemon consigns the opponent to oblivion with the Beam Shield on its left arm and the holy sword Excalibur equipped to its right arm. MagnaAngemon's special move is Heaven's Gate, which it uses to open a door into an inescapable pocket dimension, consigning its foe to oblivion.

mammothmon.description: An Ancient Digimon proved to have existed in ages long past, thanks to a multitude of evidence. The warming of the Digital World defrosted some hyper-compressed data, causing Mammothmon to appear in icy areas where the thaw had melted. Its whole body is covered in thick fur, and although this Digimon possesses tremendous ancient power, it's extremely susceptible to fire damage. The crest carved onto Mammothmon's face mask is a crystal of super-ancient wisdom, and it possesses a second sight that allows it to see long distances. Its large ears can discern sounds even in far-off places. Mammothmon's special move is Tusk Strikes, which stabs at the enemy with its two long tusks.

metalgreymon.description: An Android Digimon with more than half of its body mechanized. The MetalGreymon of File Island was able to dramatically prolong its vital functioning through self-modification, but its biological parts couldn't withstand the strain and turned blue. By contrast, this Ultimate-level MetalGreymon is a successful Digivolution from a Greymon, and is an extremely powerful Android Digimon. MetalGreymon's attack power is said to be as powerful as a nuclear warhead, capable of completely obliterating lower-level Digimon. Its special move Giga Destryoer is an attack that fires bionic missiles from a hatch that opens in its chest.

It makes its opponent feel happy by wrapping it in the love that overflows from its adorable body (although its eyes are pretty scary). Its special move Hearts Attack flings hearts at the enemy.

crowmon.description: An odd-looking Mysterious Bird Digimon with three legs. Although its jet-black body may cause those who see it to suspect it of being evil, legend has it that Crowmon is the Digimon who guides the chosen few to El Dorado, in the eastern part of the Digital World. Crowmon's special move is Savage Emperor, which channels the energy produced by the vajra on its two wings into its forelegs to fire at foes. Digimon struck by this technique have their digital cells broken down into simple ones and zeroes.

rizegreymon.description: An Android Digimon with more than half of its body mechanized. Despite RizeGreymon's massive frame, it can still take to the skies to defeat foes. The destructive force it can blast from the giant revolver on its left arm is said to be as powerful as a nuclear warhead, but the combination of this force with the recoil it generates means it generally can't fire more than one shot at a time, and to withstand the explosive power, the gun barrel has to be made of Chrondigizoid. RizeGreymon's special move Trident Revolver pushes the limits of Chrondigizoid's durability by firing a three-round burst.

It can even move around in pitch darkness by utilizing its massive ear-shaped radars, which also allow it to detect foes from a distance. Its profile is evocative of a shaved poodle. During battle, the protector on Rapidmon's neck will shut. It uses its special move Golden Triangle to unleash a beam of light from its body that breaks foes down into bits of data.

loaderleomon.description: A Machine Digimon born when the CAD data of construction machinery leaked onto a server and fused with Beast Digimon configuration data. LoaderLeomon's mane is a pneumatic drill, and it operates primarily in tunnel construction and Chrondigizoit mining. Chrondigizoit mines are often surrounded by hard layers of bedrock. In addition to its power and stamina, it also boasts top-class abilities for a Machine Digimon. Many LoaderLeomon have stubborn personalities and take pride in their work, but others simply treat them like belligerent hotheads much of the time. One mine with the best ore deposits in the world supposedly vanished as the result of a fight between multiple LoaderLeomon. LoaderLeomon's special move is Bowling Storm, which unleashes its mane in high-speed rotation.

Becoming bipedal reduced WereGarurumon's speed, but turned it into a Commando-type Digimon with enhanced offensive and defensive power, as well as a knack for tactics. Retaining the leg strength of Garurumon, its kicks are extremely powerful, and it has one of the best jumps in the world of Digimon. WereGarurumon is also extremely loyal and will do anything if ordered by its master, making it highly reliable. Its special move is Wolf Claw, which slices opponents to shreds with its sharp claws.

scorpiomon.description: A research data bank used to investigate and excavate ancient lifeforms was infected by a computer virus, which then incorporated data about these lifeforms into itself to Digivolve. Scorpiomon possesses a voracious appetite and predatory skills befitting a creature that stands at the top of an ancient food chain. It captures foes with the feelers growing from its head, then finishes them off with the sharp blade sprouting from its tail. If the tide of battle turns against Scorpiomon, it can churn up the seabed with its sharp feelers in order to hide. It uses the Radar Eyes protruding from its head like night vision goggles to ascertain foes, and then aims for a chance to strike. Scorpiomon's special move is Stinger Surprise, which launches an attack from its crossed forelimbs.

Typical of the Undead type, Enbarrmon grants its rider undying protection. The only ones that can mount it are those Enbarrmon approves of as its master. When it reaches its max speed, it causes a shockwave that inflicts heavy damage to those around it. Its special move is Dead Angle Horn, with which it leaps to the sky and charges from the enemy's blind spot.

It's fond of small creatures, which it treats with the utmost care. As a result, should anything try to stamp out these little ones, Antylamon's entire personality shifts as it transforms its hands into Bǎo Fǔ and goes on the attack. Once enraged, it won't regain its composure again until every enemy in the area has been eliminated. Its special move Bunny Blades involves spinning itself around like a tornado, using its Bǎo Fǔ to cut through everything around it.

Its special move is Galactic Flare, by which it blasts foes with strange energy waves from the furthest reaches of the cosmos.

omnishoutmon.description: OmniShoutmon is the form obtained when Omnimon bestowed a legendary Digivolution upon SHoutmon, who had unleashed its soul's seething passion. In addition to its intense fervor, its entire body is clad in Omega inForce, a power it obtained from Omnimon, so it emits a golden glow from its sharp new form. OmniShoutmon's Flame Cannon transforms the overflowing feelings of friendship in its heart into firepower, releasing a hail of bullets that can not only attack, but also become a wall of iron to protect its allies. With Hard Rock Soul, it can concentrate its fervent courage into flames that burst from its fists to either punch enemies at close range or blast them with fire from long range.

kimeramon.description: Kimeramon is a Composite Digimon. Every part of its body, including its hands, legs, torso and tail, was made by combining various parts from other Digimon. As for the reason behind its creation, that remains shrouded in mystery. Though Kimeramon is similar to Machinedramon in that it was constructed from various parts of other Digimon, the nature of the relationship between the two has yet to be discovered. Perhaps Kimeramon was a prototype for Machinedramon, except that it used organic parts instead of metal ones. Or perhaps Kimeramon was created specifically as a countermeasure against Machinedramon. What is clear, however, is Kimeramon's frightful instinct for combat, along with its immense destructive power. It can fire a deadly heat ray, Heat Viper, from its four arms. This is a horrifying technique that cruelly tears apart anything hit by the beam with all the force of Kimeramon's ire.

Purposeful and sometimes obstinate, CatchMamemon considers caring for Digi-Eggs to be its chief task. If need be, it can move around without floating by using its giant arms to walk. If the slot machine on CatchMamemon's chest rolls a triple seven as it grabs onto a foe, it transforms that Digimon into a bomb using Miracle Bomb, then uses the transformed enemy to attack. The force of the resulting explosion is said to be equal to the strength of the captured Digimon.

SuperStarmon made its debut dressed in a dazzling costume uniquely suited to its own exacting standards. Since it's a superstar, it tries to hide its identity by wearing sunglasses, but this doesn't make for a very effective disguise. skullbaluchimon.description: A giant Undead Digimon produced when some of the fossil data for the largest land mammal was counterfeited and recreated. Lacking intelligence and emotions, SkullBaluchimon moves entirely by reflex according to the nerve data running through its body. As a result, it continues to attack without reason or mercy until it can no longer move. The cold, black vapor endlessly overflowing from SkullBaluchimon's DigiCore is said to fill any Digimon with the fear of death—perhaps a curse wrought from its forced reanimation from a corpse's data. Its special move is Grave Bone, trampling the enemy beneath its giant feet and burying it within the earth.

saviorhuckmon.description: SaviorHuckmon is a Digimon that has traveled far and wide. After repeated meetings and partings with other Digimon and surviving countless scenes of carnage, it finally Digivolved into this form. SaviorHuckmon continues to join in the endless struggles that occur throughout the Digital World, seeking to bring an end to these hostilities and aid local Digimon who have suffered under the strife. SaviorHuckmon walks on two legs despite both of them being blades, and now that its arms and tail have sprouted crimson blades as well, its attack style has become more offensive. The crystal in its chest serves as physical proof of its tireless efforts to grow stronger. SaviorHuckmon's special move Trident Saber uses the crimson blades on its arms and tail to slice mercilessly through foes, even those covered in Chrondigizoid.

sirenmon.description: A Deity Digimon that looks like a mix between a bird and a fish. Cheerful by nature, Sirenmon is always seen singing happily in the air or sea. Its beautiful voice has a miraculous range of eight octaves, from ultra-low to ultra-high pitches. Sirenmon's song can bring peace to even the most devastated battlefields. They say a resplendent Digivolution awaits it in the future because of all the good deeds it's performed by healing those who listen to it. Sirenmon sings Symphony No. 1 in a high soprano that seeps into the listener's heart, paralyzing their will and leaving them at the Digimon's mercy. It sings the solemn Symphony No. 2 in a low bass that transforms into a heavy, low-frequency vibration, crushing the enemy from the insides of their ear canals and leaving them unable to even stand. Symphony No. 3 turns its voice into note-shaped bullets that it then fires at the enemy. These shots have a mysterious property, ricocheting on impact to always hit other foes as well. Each of these techniques increase in power for every creature that sings along with Sirenmon, turning even the weak into a great strength.

It's also a master of dark implements, keeping various weapons hidden in its sleeves. This Digimon doesn't say much and usually resides in the dark. Taomon can also change talismans into familiars known as shikigami. It uses its special move Talisman of Light to paint a Sanskrit character in midair while chanting before hurling it at the enemy. Digitamamon is the apex of Digivolution, and supposedly Digivolves not from a normal Digimon, but only by fusing with data from another dimension. Its egg-shaped exoskeleton renders all attacks useless. Its special move Nightmare Syndrome is a ball of darkness.

Its attack and defense capabilities have increased several levels, and it wields supreme destructive power in addition to the might of its flames. Fire Digimon are weak against Water and Ice-Snow types to begin with, but any interaction on their part with SkullMeramon is like water sizzling off a heated stone. Much like Kiwimon, Deramon has plantlike qualities and can't fly. It's extremely prideful and believes itself to be a noble being, but is secretly ashamed of not being able to soar the skies. Still, its Digivolution to Ultimate means it boasts considerable battle power. The crown atop its head and its glittering gold beak are points of pride for Deramon. Its hide is among the toughest of all biological Digimon. Similarly, the two ultra-hard horns on its forehead are much more solid than Monochromon's horn. Though generally placid by nature, Triceramon's charging attack belies its slow movements, and packs enough destructive force to shatter even the sturdy bodies of Mineral Digimon. Its form is the result of the interface on its forehead unlocking the dragon data lying dormant deep within its DigiCore, filled with the powerful life force of that mythical beast. With its overwhelming size, it's able to utterly crush any Digimon daring enough to oppose it, and its power enables it to repel an attack from Nightmare Soldiers with a single flap of its wings. DoruGreymon is also highly intelligent, and since it only rarely reveals itself, simply being able to find it is extremely difficult. Its special move Metal Meteor unleashes a supermassive iron sphere more than ten times its own immense size, wiping out its foes all at once.

Knightmon is a faithful Digimon whose existence is founded on loyal service. It adopts the attributes of its master as its own faith, laboring either in the service of justice or wickedness. It uses its special move Berserk Sword to cleave all things in two with a rampaging swing of its blade.

It likes to think of itself as a lone wolf, but it's secretly jealous of Monzaemon, a popular Digimon with a similar look. Still, Pandamon is surprisingly capable in battle, and is quick to send any who disturb it packing. The Pandamon population is small, making it a rare sight. According to urban legend, Pumpkinmon was created when a computer virus commonly circulated around Halloween time suddenly mutated. The virus wasn't malicious, so this Digimon never harms people, but Pumpkinmon is quite strong despite its appearance. As one look at their blankly staring faces will tell you, Puppet Digimon tend not to express emotion very clearly, and Pumpkinmon is no exception. Though normal Mamemon are about the same size as In-Training Digimon, they pack more power into their small frames than appearances would imply. BigMamemon, on the other hand, lives up to its name by being dozens, if not hundreds, of times larger than its smaller kin. At this size, why it's still referred to as "Mamemon," named for its small stature, is unclear. BigMamemon has a warm, gentle personality, and isn't fond of conflict or battle. It can always be found playing with its Mamemon followers. Its special move Big Smiley Bomber uses the Mamemon under its command as weapons. While small, it possesses a special skill that allows it to seal off the abilities of its foes and pulverize its opponents with a single, powerful strike. Piximon loves a good prank, and enjoys making computers run amok with the beloved spear "Fairy Tale" it always wields (not that it bears any ill will). It's also more intelligent than Seadramon, and will relentlessly seek out and destroy foes like a homing torpedo. Possessed of a mercurial and tomboyish personality, it's said to open its heart to human girls of the same disposition. Lillymon can also be a crybaby, and becomes inconsolable once it starts sobbing, making this one of the harder Digimon to tame. But Lillymon will also offer a helping hand to the small and the weak. Able to fly using the four leaf-like wings on its back, a gentle breeze is said to follow in Lillymon's wake. Its special move is Flower Cannon, with which it extends both of its arms, turns the flowers on its wrists into the mouth of a cannon and fires an energy bomb.

In the Digital World, where a large quantity of data must be moved around, transporting said data as quickly as possible is the ultimate reason that Vehicle-species Digimon like Locomon exist. There are times, though, when the older-model Locomon has run off the rails in its pursuit of ever-greater speeds. And although its movement is confined to the tracks, there are occasions when it's generated rifts in spacetime by continuously running in loops. Locomon can also use its special move Wheel Grinder to spin and then throw its spiked wheels.

The bullets Astamon fires from its beloved machine gun, "Oro Salmón," have a will of their own, and will pursue their targets literally to the farthest corners of hell. Astamon's special move, Mad Dog Fire, fires all the bullets in its Oro Salmón in a deadly barrage.

Arukenimon specializes in transforming into a humanoid form, letting it approach potential prey while its guard is down. Short-tempered and ferocious, its nature elicits a sense of trepidation from a great many other Digimon. Arukenimon's special move is Spider Thread, which mangles enemies with sharp wires.

Myotismon has an extremely cruel and cunning personality, and is an insidiously difficult Digimon to destroy. However, it can only make full use of its powers at night. During the day, Myotismon is apparently reduced to only half-strength. Its special move Night Raid commands a swarm of bats to ambush its foes.

Okuwamon's ability to detect foes with its antennae has been boosted, and its pincer attacks have augmented precision. Furthermore, it's clear that its most prominent characteristics aren't only its survival instinct, but also its destructive impulse. Truly a Digivolution steeped in aggression. Its special move Double Scissor Claw is an upgraded version of Scissor Claw that's able to slice through even the hardest diamond.

Its strength was such that it drove an entire area to the brink of destruction, until it was sealed away by the servant of a being seeking to maintain harmony in the Digital World Orochimon's special move is Ame no Murakumo, which transforms the end of its tail into a sharp blade to rend its foes.

Its can is like a black hole, and those sucked into it disappear from the Digital World without a trace. Its special move Poop Bazooka is a vile attack fired from a bazooka Garbagemon made from empty cans.

Groundramon likes living in veins of rare Huanglong Ore, and in fact the scales covering its body are very likely composed of the same material. Its personality is quite brutal, and most who encounter it wind up losing their lives. Groundramon uses its special move Scrapless Claw to crush enemies with its back arms.

Known as the "Lord of the Deep Forest," it's a terrifying Digimon that lures those who wander into the depths of the dark forest ever farther inside so they can never leave again. Its body produces a hallucinogenic mist to lure Digimon deep into the forest. It then uses its branch-like tentacles and vines to capture its enemies and draw nourishment from them. Should you ever encounter an old Woodmon, it may be best to defeat it before it can Digivolve into Cherrymon. Cherrymon's special move Cherry Bomb makes use of the forbidden fruit growing in the thick branches on its head.

Without a scrap of intelligence or reason left to restrain its instinct, SkullGreymon's existence is a threat to other Digimon. Its special move is an organic missile fired from its spinal cord. The latest research suggests that this attack eventually evolved into Oblivion Bird, which adds a new tracking function and dramatically upgrades both power and range.

SkullSatamon's special move Nail Bone is a horrifying technique that unleashes an intense light from the jewel on the tip of its staff, disrupting and obliterating its opponent's data.

Once SkullSeadramon gets ahold of a foe, it coils its long form around it and squeezes the life out of it with Death Roll. Its special move Lightning Javelin launches a sharp electrical shock from the blade atop its head. This attack grows in power the longer it's charged.

Dragomon bundles its countless tentacles into a humanoid shape, but its actual identity is a Digivolution of a strange Mollusk Digimon. Dragomon's special move is Forbidden Trident, with which it hurls its trident with tremendous strength. For its defeated foes, it holds the rosary around its neck and adopts a sort of mourning pose.

It excels at eliminating multiple targets, and boasts overwhelming firepower. Equipped with a special radar capable of locking on to 30 targets at once, an individual Tankdramon can also sync targets with others, and it's said to be impossible to escape them all. Casualty rates among Tankdramon are also extremely low, and reportedly, only one has ever been lost in the field. Tankdramon's special move Striver Cannon fires a shell equipped with a small nuclear warhead to utterly destroy everything within a 20-mile radius.

Its special move Musical Fist uses its vocal chords and horns to create an ultra-low frequency wave that corrupts the data of its foes. It will try—albeit poorly—to "rebuild" the data of correctly-functioning computers. Its forte is destroying any kind of data. No matter how strong the Digimon, Datamon will easily destroy the data that comprises its body. Its special move is Digital Bomb, which fires an attack from its fingertips.

Phantomon uses this ability to find those on the verge of death. It's said that the inside of the cloth concealing its body is connected to the Digital World of another dimension. It uses its fluttering garments to befuddle foes, slashing those who let their guard down with the countless rapiers hidden inside the deceptively soft cloth of its sleeves. As a vampire, Matadormon must sustain itself by drinking Digimon blood, but not just any will do, and so it wanders from land to land in search of strong Digimon to feed upon. lucemon-cm.description: Both divine and diabolical, this Ultimate Evil King Digimon is the strongest of the Seven Great Demon Lords. Lucemon: Chaos Mode instigated a rebellion in ancient times, and was sealed away in the Dark Area along with many other Evil King Digimon. Its power exceeds that of Mega Digimon, so much so that it even rivals the entity considered "God." Although it has a godlike side that cherishes all living things, it also has a demonic side that wants to annihilate the world itself. This is why it aims to destroy this world and build a new one in its stead. Its special move Paradise Lost launches its enemy high into the air with a wild barrage before it grabs its limbs and slams it into the ground, while Dead or Alive seals the enemy within a three-dimensional magic circle made from holy and evil spheres. Those caught in this magic circle have a 50/50 chance of either being completely obliterated or taking heavy damage.

There are almost no instances of one of these Digimon being successfully cultivated on a personal computer. LadyDevimon's special move is Darkness Wave, which releases countless, flying, batlike creatures that burn the opponent to a crisp.

wisemon.description: Completely shrouded in mystery, Wisemon can appear at any point in time and space via its "Book." Using this Book as a spiritual vessel, it frequently alters its form to appear in locations in spacetime connected to the Book, and so some believe that its true form must exist in a different dimension. Some researchers speculate that Wisemon is a Wizard Digimon like Piedmon. The Spacetime Stones in its hands can record and play back regions in spacetime, and have saved all the events and objects of the Digital World. Its special move Pandora Dialogue is a high-speed replay of enemy attacks stored in spacetime.

This Digimon has grown even craftier and more persistent than MegaSeadramon when it comes to chasing down prey. WaruSeadramon's special move is Darkstrom, which swallows foes up with whirlpools composed of dark power.

shakkoumon.description: A Mutant Digimon DNA Digivolved from Ankylomon and Angemon. Shakkoumon has a shiny silver body with white wings, and according to one theory, it's actually an Angel Digimon that descended from on high into the Ancient Digital World. Since it can rotate its head and torso a full 360 degrees, it's capable of attacking in any direction. Some people find it frightening because its lack of expression makes it impossible to tell what it's thinking, but it has a warm and gentle personality. Its special move Disaster Blaster shoots destructive red laser beams from its eyes. These lasers are said to reach temperatures of over 180,000 degrees Fahrenheit at their focal point.

Upon reaching these heights, it then spreads its arms and sails through the air like a glider. Silphymon uses the radar devices on its ears to gather information, then visually processes this data for viewing on its head-mounted display, allowing it to pinpoint an enemy's location, day or night. It uses its special move Top Gun to extend its arms to fire an energy bomb.

While Dinobeemon can't be easily classified as either a Dragon or an Insectoid type, its insect qualities are quite prominent. Flying through the air on its four wings, this Digimon tracks its foes unerringly with its compound eyes before choking the life out of them with harsh certainty. Dinobeemon is also exceedingly barbaric by nature. It uses its special move Hell Masquerade to perform a “dance of Hell,” cutting through foes with movements fast enough to leave afterimages.

paildramon.description: A Dragon Man Digimon DNA Digivolved from an ExVeemon and a Stingmon. It retains many elements of Dragon types, with the power of a dragon and the iron-wall defense of an insect's carapace. More than just powerful, Paildramon also uses quick and agile moves to finish off opponents. It's very loyal, and will unquestioningly lay down its life for its master. Paildramon uses its special move Death Parade Blaster to fire an energy wave from two biological cannons extending from its waist.

infermon.description: An Ultimate Digimon similar in appearance to a long-legged spider. In its normal form, Infermon has its limbs and head extended, but it can also take on a cocoon form where it draws its limbs inside its body. In cocoon form, its defense increases to the point where it can repel any attack, although this limits its movement to a straight line. It can easily overcome the tightest security to infiltrate any network. Should Infermon ever be released onto the Net, the world would be plunged into chaos. Its special move Spider Shooter fires an energy bomb of incredible destructive power from the gunport in its mouth.

aldamon.description: A Digimon whose power over fire exceeds that of legend due to the unknown powers it obtained by fully inheriting the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Aldamon is a Demon God who transforms fear and anger into a righteous power to fight. Its violent behavior earns it many enemies, but its name reflects the fused form of a god in Hindu mythology, combining the wildness of a beast with the intelligence of a human. In battle, it unleashes attacks over incredibly large areas, melting and burning everything to a crisp. This aspect is a destructive power akin to the threat of a modern nuclear weapon. Aldamon uses its special move Atomic Inferno to fire a rapid-fire stream of super-hot bullets from the Rudriya Darpana superweapons on its arms. It can also use its Rudriya Darpana for melee, and specializes in close-range combat.

beowolfmon.description: A Digimon whose power over light exceeds that of legend due to the unknown powers it obtained by fully inheriting the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Beowolfmon possesses both the instincts of a beast and the intelligence of a human. A warrior of exceptional strength, it easily wields its twin-bladed greatsword Trinität with just one hand. In battle, it always remains thoughtful and composed, although as a warrior, it believes in the virtues of fighting for its friends and facing off against greater foes. Thanks to the long-distance missile pod on its left arm, the Roland 2, it excels at both long-range and close-range combat. Its special move is Zweihänder, an attack with which it swings the greatsword Trinität down at near-lightspeed to cleave through foes.
