This awesome strength, capable of melting down and purifying any substance, is such that even Apollomon—with all its intense fervor and pride—can barely contain it. Apollomon's special moves are Sol Blaster, which unleashes an incandescent solar orb formed from the flame sphere on its back, and Phoebus Blow, which concentrates all of its latent power into a single punch.

alphamon.description: One of the 13 Royal Knights, who are said to be the highest-ranking Digimon when it comes to Network security. Although Alphamon itself is a Holy Knight, it's said to act as a deterrent to other Holy Knights. It typically prefers to remain hidden, and is widely known as the "Aloof Hermit," identifiable by the blue cape that flutters around it. The position it occupies in the Royal Knights is known as the "Empty Seat." In battle, it has the ability to access Alpha inForce, an ultimate power that can instantly reverse what would otherwise be a lost cause. Its special moves are Blade of the Dragon King, which involves drawing out light gathered in the center of a magic circle, then using it to pierce a foe, and Soul Digitalization, which involves spreading the wings on its back to take flight, then creating a giant magic circle in the sky, which it uses to summon a legendary monster from another dimension.

ulforceveedramon.description: UlforceVeedramon is a legendary Holy Knight Digimon appearing only in a prophecy passed down from the Ancient Digital World. The appearance of the Royal Knights, the holy defenders of the Network, was written of in this prophecy, and it's said the members of the Royal Knights will all gather because of this prophecy when the Digital World faces its greatest crisis. Even among the Royal Knights, UlforceVeedramon's speed is exceptional, such that it's impossible to follow its movements. It has V-Bracelets on both arms, and is clad in armor made of Blue Digizoid, an extremely rare metal, allowing it to shoot through the sky and blast across the earth. Its special move is The Ray of Victory, with which it fires a beam of energy from the V-shaped armor on its chest to wipe out foes.

varodurumon.description: A mythical Holy Bird Digimon that lives in the stratosphere over 130,000 feet above ground. Varodurumon has six giant wings, with the largest pair having a nearly 100-foot wingspan. Referred to in myth as a guardian of the sky, legend has it that this ancient Digimon has existed ever since the creation of the Digital World. Varodurumon's feathers constantly give off the holy light known as "Purge Shine," which serves as a barrier that completely nullifies any attack made with evil intent. Its special move is Aurora Undulation, which amplifies the purifying light of Purge Shine to peak brightness before unleashing it upon its foes.

venusmon.description: This compassionate Digimon governs the power of love, and is one of the Olympos XII. Even in the most desolate wastelands, wherever Venusmon goes, beautiful flowers bloom and the earth around it is renewed with youthful vigor. Many Digimon worship Venusmon because of its beauty and purity. By wearing a blindfold, it's able to perceive the world as it truly is with its mind's eye, seeing through any falsehood or deceit. Hiding its eyes also suppresses its aura of glamor, doubling as an act of consideration and reducing the number of Digimon that would otherwise swoon in its presence. Venusmon has two small but constant companions, the bird Olive and the scallop Hotan, and the three friends keep up an open and lively conversation. Since Venusmon is the Digimon that governs love, its every action in battle soothes its opponents' hearts. With LOVE YOU, it can make a foe fall unconscious by blowing it a kiss and making its heart skip a beat. If its bird Olive pecks an enemy on the head, it falls under the spell of Peace Fantasia, which can soothe the heart of even the most savage of beasts.

wargreymon.description: The strongest dragon warrior, wearing armor crafted from the super-metal Chrondigizoid, WarGreymon is the ultimate form of the Greymon species. It sports a more humanoid physique than the typical large bodies of other Greymon types, but possesses vastly improved power and speed. It may be impossible to defeat with the attacks of Ultimate-level Digimon. The "Dramon Killers" attached to WarGreymon's arms deal massive damage to Dramon-species Digimon, but also expose WarGreymon to danger, making them double-edged swords. WarGreymon can also combine the exoskeleton parts on its back to form the hardest of shields, "Brave Shield." It's said that even among the most battle-hardened of veterans, it's only when one of true valor realizes its own destiny that it Digivolves into a WarGreymon. WarGreymon's special move is the super dense, high temperature energy beam Terra Force, with which it concentrates all the energy in the atmosphere into a single point before blasting it forward. It also uses Great Tornado to join the Dramon Killers on its arms above its head to perform a spinning, high-speed charge that pierces the enemy.

ouryumon.description: An imaginary Digimon born from the daydream of a DigiCore. The interface on Ouryumon's forehead miraculously unlocked the creative power of its own DigiCore, causing it to Digivolve into this form. Perhaps because this DigiCore already contained such fierce combat data as warlords and dragons from Japanese mythology, the form it dreamed up was that of a dragon warrior clad in imposing Japanese-style armor, wielding a sword in each hand. The blade in Ouryumon's left hand is called Gairyu Sadaijin, while the one in its right is named Gairyu Udaijin. The blades extending from the wings on its back are called the Gaiba Daimeijin. Ouryumon's special moves are Eiseiryuojin, which unleashes an attack from the blades in both hands, and Golden Armor, with which it rages forward with the destructive force of a mighty river overflowing its banks.

Together with Seraphimon and Cherubimon, Ophanimon is one of the Three Celestial Digimon who guard the area known as the Kernel (or Domain of the Gods) in the heart of the Digital World. Ophanimon represents the merciful and compassionate aspects of the gods, serving as the holy mother of the Digital World, while Seraphimon is the unforgiving marshall of the gods and Cherubimon is the steadfast defender of the gods and wisdom. Each has its own role to play. Ophanimon's special moves are EDEN's Javelin and Sefirot Crystal.

This gate is sealed by 360 doors, and ClavisAngemon holds "The Key," a master key that unlocks them all. The Key is special in that it can only be wielded by this Digimon. Some suspect that ClavisAngemon itself is a part of said key. The power embedded in The Key could apparently collapse the very Digital World itself, but is only used against foes who would destroy the doors.

Craniamon is a perfectionist, vying with other Royal Knights for the highest completion rate of orders from King Drasil. When fighting enemies, its policy is to eliminate them in one-on-one combat. The more formidable the foe, the more reason it has to rejoice. The code of Craniamon's armor has been manipulated by King Drasil into Black Digizoid. Craniamon uses the special move Waltz's End to spin its magic lance Claíomh Solais at a high speed, unleashing a supersonic Sonic Wave. Furthermore, it can use its magic shield Avalon to activate Breath of the Gods.

It's said that Eaglemon's duty is to eliminate any alien elements that invade the Digital World. It uses its special move Kaiser Phoenix to ram the enemy with its full-metal body, or Mystic Break to shoot a white ray that reduces the enemy to ash.

chronomon-hm.description: A Deity Digimon said to be a materialization of the system that governs time. The flow of time in the Digital World is truly vague, and some conflicts between powerful Digimon or cataclysms have been known to cause space-time disturbances. It's Chronomon that appears on such occasions, bearing the responsibility of mending space-time. Once it makes such a restoration, even the fact that Chronomon appeared disappears alongside the space-time disturbance itself, thus no one has ever laid eyes on this Digimon. This is why its existence is only spoken of in a scant few legends. Chronomon's special moves are Holy Flare, a blast of holy flame that burns away the very existences of any who maliciously seek to warp space-time, and Chronos Crop, an unblockable attack in which it swings its wings like blades, cleaving its foe from the fabric of time and space itself.

goldramon.description: Goldramon is a Holy Dragon Digimon with six hardened wings and a body of glittering gold. Since it wears one of the Holy Rings—the symbol of holy Digimon—upon its arm, it's believed to be a kind of sacred Digimon. Goldramon is one of the Four Great Dragons, and it wears vambraces with tiny dragon Digimon sealed within them upon its arms: Amon of Crimson Flame, which governs destruction, on its right, and Umon of Blue Thunder, which governs regeneration, on its left. Goldramon's special move is God Flame, which involves detonating its holy energy to instantly fell enemies in all directions.

One of its special moves is Glorious Burst, with which it spreads its giant wings while concentrating the light energy inside them to the upper limit, then unleashes it all at once. It also has the ability to summon the GeoGrey Sword, a weapon that has all of Gaia's power concentrated within its blade.

justimon.description: A heroic Digimon wearing a fluttering red scarf. Burning with a sense of justice, this Digimon never overlooks injustice or evil deeds, making it beloved by In-Training Digimon. Justimon comes in like the wind, swings down the iron hammer of justice, and then vanishes just as quickly. It also seems to enjoy striking a pose on a cliffside with its back to the setting sun. Swapping through the three plugs of the Extend Transmitter equipped on its back lets it alternate between the power-type Accel Arm, the electric-type Blitz Arm, and the cutter-type Critical Arm. Its signature move Trinity Arm allows Justimon to swap between its three arms, and special move Justice Kick boasts over 45 tons of destructive power.

SkullMammothmon's survival instinct as a Vaccine-attribute type has only grown stronger after death. In order to keep fighting, it's shed all emotion and intellect that doesn't aid in the extermination of viruses. As long as the DigiCore shining in its chest remains unharmed, SkullMammothmon can maintain vital activity even as a skeleton. The moment this exposed DigiCore is attacked, however, it spells the end for this Digimon. SkullMammothmon's special move is Spiral Bone, hurling and spinning one of its vertebrae at high speed.

From its twin arm blades to its metal wings, the razor-sharp body of this angel warrior was without a doubt born to battle wicked beings. SlashAngemon's signature move is Blade of the True, and its special move is Golden Ripper, charging at foes with tremendous force to carve them up with the blades on its body.

Kentaurosmon is an outlier among the mostly humanoid Digimon of the Royal Knights, possessing an atypical bestial form. The defensive strength of the Red Digizoid armor encasing its body makes damaging this Digimon no mean feat, even for Mega Digimon. Six legs offer Kentaurosmon superior mobility, allowing for instantaneous movement in spite of its large frame. It uses its special move Bifrost to fire an incandescent arrow of light from the holy crossbow Múspellsheimr on its left arm, or Odin's Breath to control the weather, generating a cryogenic blizzard with the holy shield Niflheimr on its right arm.

slayerdramon.description: A Dragon Man Digimon covered in Chrondigizoid scale armor. This form can only be achieved by those who complete the Trial of the Four Great Dragons—a test that Dragon Digimon alone can undertake. Slayerdramon carries the telescoping greatsword Fragarach, and has mastered Ryuzanken, an ultimate sword style of its own making with three forms. There's the first form, Tenryu Slash, with which it spins its body to accelerate the blade, driving it downward to bisect its foe from top to bottom. The second form is Shoryu Slash, which tempers a dragon wave with Slayerdramon's blade, unleashing it in an upward motion to mow down the enemy with sword pressure alone. The third form is Koryu Slash, which coils the Fragarach around the opponent after stepping in close, shaving away at its entire body with the wrapped blade.

seraphimon.description: A Seraph Digimon with ten golden wings and clad in glittering silver holy armor. Seraphimon is the greatest of all Angel Digimon, reigning over all of its brethren. Its true face and identity are hidden from public view behind a mask. Even so, it's the closest being to those embodiments of good known as "gods." It's said that Seraphimon will descend for a final battle against wicked beings, purifying them all. The Digimon Creepymon, which fell to the Dark Area and became an Evil King Digimon, is said to have originally been a Seraphimon. Seraphimon's special moves are Strike of the Seven Stars, which fires seven orbs of high-temperature light at the opponent, and Testament, an ultimate technique that induces a Big Bang in exchange for its life.

The former utilizes heat-based ordnance, unlike the latter's cold-based ordnance, with all sorts of weapons—such as lasers, missiles, bazookas and flamethrowers—hidden throughout its giant body. MegaGargomon is incredibly slow, but all that energy is converted directly into power, giving it unbelievable destructive capabilities. Because it compensates for its lack of speed with force, it can deal with attacks from all directions without taking a single step. It uses its special move Burst Shot to open fire with a volley of firearms.

durandamon.description: Durandamon is the Digimon with the ultimate holy sword. It Digivolved by improving its own sword to the utmost limit, and by taking in data on various holy swords from games and myths alike. It's said that whoever holds Durandamon's sword holds the key to victory, and Durandamon is among the most powerful of all the Legend-Arms that transform into swords. Its slashes are so fierce they can cleave any defensive barrier in two. According to record, only the strongest of the Legend-Arms that transform into shields are capable of withstanding it. Durandamon's special moves are Zwei Glänze, with which it slices through foes by channeling its fighting spirit into its blade-arms, and Thron Messer, a spinning slash capable of felling several enemies at once. Although both of these moves are strong enough to finish opponents in a single blow, Durandamon's most compelling capability remains its powerful slashing attack in weapon form.

neptunemon.description: One of the Olympos XII, Neptunemon is a marine god Digimon that governs all aquatic-species Digimon. The scale mail covering its body is a Chrondigizoid alloy called Blue Digizoid that facilitates mobility and speed, allowing it to move at a fearsome pace underwater. Its castle Abyss Sanctuary was built in a deep underwater trench, and only those who can withstand the water pressure of the extreme depths can enter. Its special moves include Vortex Penetration, with which it strikes with King's Bite, its sentient spear, and Wave of Depth, with which it unleashes a massive tsunami that swallows up everything in its path.

hiandromon.description: HiAndromon is a Mega Android Digimon created by upgrading and completing the unfinished Andromon. It features a higher percentage of Chrondigizoid parts in the composition of its body, which alone should make it clear that HiAndromon has a level of offensive and defensive power that Andromon could never match. The addition of Chrondigizoid parts to the incomplete bio-synapse circuits responsible for Andromon's thought processes has given HiAndromon the ability to think for itself and pursue its own objectives. Its special move is Atomic Ray, which involves joining its hands to fuse the neutronic energy from the blue neutron control turbine in its right shoulder with the atomic energy from the red atomic control turbine in its left shoulder and firing a beam of light to obliterate foes.

bancholeomon.description: BanchoLeomon is a Beast Man Digimon that answers only to its own sense of justice. It's said that only Digimon that have continued to triumph over incredibly powerful foes without having their spirits broken earn the title of "Bancho"—a term that loosely translates to "ringleader." In all the recorded history of the Digital World, only five Digimon have ever been confirmed to have this in their names. BanchoLeomon opposes anything that stands in the way of its justice. Even if it's one of the Royal Knights or one of the Three Celestial Digimon, BanchoLeomon won't hesitate to brand them as an evil foe that must be destroyed. BanchoLeomon also boasts a powerful defense, as it can use the gakuran jacket draped over its shoulders to negate 89.9 percent of the damage caused by an opponent's physical attacks. BanchoLeomon's special moves include Lion Slash, an attack with its beloved shortsword Otokodama, and Flashy Boss Punch, which involves channeling all of its considerable energy into a single punch.

herculeskabuterimon.description: The ultimate Insectoid Digimon, HerculesKabuterimon Digivolved by combining data from both the Kabuterimon and the Kuwagamon species. Possessing a giant horn as well as huge pincers, HerculesKabuterimon is said to perfectly compensate for the weaknesses of these two species with opposing dispositions that it Digivolved from. Its body glitters gold, and having both regained and improved upon the ability to fly it lost as MegaKabuterimon, HerculesKabuterimon zooms around the Digital World at supersonic speeds. There are few who can rival HerculesKabuterimon in this Mega form. HerculesKabuterimon uses its special move is Giga Blaster, an upgraded version of Electro Shocker. Just as Magnadramon is the ultimate beast Digimon, Phoenixmon is the ultimate bird Digimon. Since it has not one but two Holy Rings, which draw out holy power and serve to identify holy Digimon, Phoenixmon evidently possesses immeasurable power. Phoenixmon's special move is Starlight Explosion, with which it flaps its four godly wings to rain down golden particles of light. Anything hit by this attack is said to be cleansed of all evil.

However, it's said that once, when a great dark power arose in the Digital World, Magnadramon appeared as if from nowhere and reduced that evil to nothing with its immense strength. Its special move is Fire Tornado, which blasts its opponent with a radiant beam of pure justice. Anyone struck by this attack is instantly reduced to nothingness.

It faces this predicament by controlling the might of both Angel and Dark Angel clans summoned through gates from another Digital World. Mastemon accomplishes this through a temperament that has earned it the moniker of the "Tactician from Another World," enabling these normally hostile factions to work together. It's of a single mind despite being a DNA Digivolution of two conflicting creatures, controlling both light and dark energies and lending power to Digimon in various situations. It even attacks formidable foes on its own. Mastemon uses its special move Holy Desire to destroy evildoers with arrows of light fired from its right arm, Dark Despair to grab a foe with its left arm and delete them by crushing their entire DigiCore, and Chaos Degradation to produce a gate from the fusion of light and dark energies in both arms that consigns the enemy to oblivion in another dimension.

Despite the "Angemon" in its name, it's actually completely distinct from the Angemon species in terms of its ecosystem. The ring around MarineAngemon's neck is called a "Holy Ring," causing speculation that it has some relation to holy Digimon such as Gatomon or Angewomon, who also wear such rings. The characters inscribed on its ring have yet to be deciphered. Though MarineAngemon generally avoids combat, its special move Ocean Love causes foes to lose the will to fight, thereby guaranteeing victory.

marsmon.description: This war god Digimon resembling a leopard humanoid is one of the mysterious Olympos XII, who possess abilities rivaling even the Royal Knights, guardian deities of the Net. Each of the Olympos XII protects its own region, acting in the shadows and maintaining a neutral position during incidents in the Digital World. Marsmon well understands all hand-to-hand techniques in the world—including skills utilizing foul play—and possesses absolute confidence in any one-on-one fight against those like itself. It relies mostly on wrestling moves, but its focus on victory and glory means it will whip out hidden weapons like its Tria Knuckles or Metal Cothurnus when it finds itself on its back foot. Even so, Marsmon brings its true power to bear when fighting with bare hands and feet. Its special move is Corona Sanctions, with which it engulfs itself in flames for a glorious mid-air killing technique.

jupitermon.description: A member of the Olympos XII, a god that presides over the heavens, and a Digimon that governs thunder and weather. Jupitermon always judges good and evil on the battlefield, delivering divine punishment to the wicked. Such judgment is handed down indifferently, without emotion. Those who disagree with Jupitermon's decision can challenge it and overturn the judgment upon victory, but, as of now, no one has ever accomplished this feat. It can clap the hammers on both arms together to summon small thunderclouds. It uses Punish Judge to strike an opponent with its hammer, engraving a mark on its body and postponing its punishment. When Jupitermon decides to execute said punishment, the sentence is carried out by striking that foe with extremely high-voltage lightning. It uses its ultimate special move Wide Plasment to change its body into ultra-high-voltage plasma. This inflicts divine punishment in the area around Jupitermon, disintegrating any and all it touches.

ravemon.description: An Android Digimon that possesses wings made of Chrondigizoid. Ravemon served Deity Digimon as "the Silver Crow" at the creation of the Digital World, but it was struck by the gods' anger and had one of its wings dyed black as a result. The true terror of Ravemon is in its covert actions. It conceals itself with its dark wing, and slashes at foes with its white wing. Appearing out of nowhere, it takes the enemy out with a single swift attack. It uses its special move Spiral Raven Claw to unleash a spinning charge into the enemy with the sharp claws on its left arm. In addition, it defeats the enemy with its blade "Raven King Sword," which it uses with deft movements, and the black lightning blade released from this sword, Ame no Ohabari, has enormous destructive power.

ultimatebrachiomon.description: UltimateBrachiomon is the largest and heaviest land-based Android Digimon. The boosters on its back fire downwards to help support the immense weight of its massive frame, and it relies on them to move. UltimateBrachiomon was remodeled to be an extreme heavyweight, and as a result it's anything but fast. Since its armor is so thick, though, it has no need to dodge enemy attacks, and any other Digimon without at least as much weight would be unable to bear the recoil of firing the superweapon that is its chest cannon. Its special moves include Ultimate Blast, which causes the energy inside its body to explode, releasing a powerful shockwave from its chest cannon, and Ultimate Quake, with which it attacks with its giant tail, striking the enemy with earthshaking force.

vulcanusmon.description: This Digimon god of smithing is one of the Olympos XII. Vulcanusmon is responsible for creating most of the Digital World's best-known weapons, including the infamous Beelzemon's beloved Berenjena. Vulcanusmon has the spirit of a true craftsman, along with an obstinate personality. It takes the measure of all of its clients, and if it feels they can't master or won't treasure the weapon they've requested, it denies them. Even when Vulcanusmon does agree to make a weapon, it aligns the quality of its work to its impression of the wielder. Nevertheless, Vulcanusmon was so taken with Beelzemon's strength that it worked diligently to craft an exceptional weapon when it created Berenjena. Vulcanusmon prefers to be left in peace, working away with its eight arms, but can also leverage its skill as a craftsman in battle. With its special move Pinpoint Weapon Works, it makes masterful use of its fiery "Bomber Art" welder to instantly craft the perfect weapon for any combat situation. When it really wants to go all out, though, it uses Appropriate Works, which uses Pinpoint Weapon Works repeatedly to forge weapons for each of its eight arms. Despite all this, Vulcanusmon's own combat ability isn't particularly high, and it prefers to avoid battle whenever possible.

gankoomon.description: A Holy Knight Digimon and successor to the position of one of the Royal Knights. Together with Huckmon, who it hopes to make its successor, Gankoomon journeys all over the Digital World, quelling chaos and disturbances before they can get out of hand. Since it intends to make Huckmon succeed it as a Royal Knight, Gankoomon puts Huckmon through a series of severe trials. Gankoomon is stubborn, which leads it to be harsh on Huckmon, although this is in fact a reflection of its kindness, since it wants to make Huckmon the equal of any other Royal Knight. Hinukamuy is the projection from its body that, while it doesn't speak, helps Gankoomon without question. Gankoomon's special move is Quake! Blast! Fire! Father! This attack involves Hinukamuy delivering divine punishment in response to a shout from Gankoomon. It also uses Table Flip, with which it flips over part of the ground as if it were a table made of Chrondigizoid.

kuzuhamon.description: Kuzuhamon is a Deity Digimon. It's said to be a Digimon of the fox species that lived a long life and then transformed into human form. Legend has it that only the greatest of these transforming-fox Digimon are capable of Digivolving into Sakuyamon. Normally, they Digivolve into Kuzuhamon. Kuzuhamon is well-versed in the ancient magics of Shinto, Taoism and Shugendo. A single pipe fox resides in the pipe on its belt, which can be used for attacking, gathering information, and more. Kuzuhamon's signature move Illuminator involves attacking with the pipe fox it carries on its belt. With its special move Taizoukai Mandala, Kuzuhamon creates a purifying field that exorcises evil using its Shakujou staff.

While capable of flying through the skies with its wings, it usually stays in deserts or mountain caves. Gryphonmon's a difficult foe to beat, and it uses its incredible power and agility to toy with its opponents. Making use of these strengths, it's employed across the Internet to prevent illegal access and to safeguard confidential information. Its special move Supersonic Voice emits super-high-frequency sound waves that destroy an enemy's data structure.

ceresmon.description: One of the Olympos XII, Ceresmon is a gigantic bird Digimon that bears the forest Karpos Hulē on its back. Karpos Hulē is where the most delectable sweets in the Digital World can be found, and many famous fruits grow there as well. With a body composed of giant rocks and fertile soil, Ceresmon in flight resembles a floating island more than anything else. Ceresmon Medium, which is Ceresmon's true form, resides at the head of the island. Ceresmon Medium possesses almost no combat ability and rarely appears before others. However, on rare occasions, it apparently shows itself to those it trusts without bringing along the giant bird. Ceresmon Medium has a gentle personality and a heart overflowing with compassion. It offers hungry Digimon fruits from Karpos Hulē, and allows injured Digimon to take shelter in the forest until they've recovered. However, if any prove ungrateful for the bounty of nature, bring harm to the trees or defile the land for sport, Ceresmon Medium's nature shifts and it becomes a truly frightful forest demon. Ceresmon's special move is Island Freefall, with which it slams its massive body directly into its foe, sending powerful tremors and violent winds surging in a wide berth around the crash site. Ceresmon also has Burning Blood Shell, which shoots a huge, scorching ball of magma from its mouth.

One theory even posits that this may be a Leomon turned feral. SaberLeomon's speed allows it to dodge even the swiftest attacks with ease. It's known as "the ultimate Digimon" due to the tremendous destructive power afforded by its two developed fangs and sharp claws. SaberLeomon's special move Infinity Arrow hardens the countless hairs on its mane before firing them at the opponent. These hairs are venomous, paralyzing anything they come in contact with. Howling Crusher is a fearsome technique with which SaberLeomon eviscerates the enemy using its giant claws.

It always carries four pipes on its belt, in which reside four pipe foxes. The pipe foxes can be used for attacking, gathering information and more. Jesmon is trusting of others, and in part to keep itself from growing overconfident, prefers to work in a team. Learning by watching the Hinukamuy of its master Gankoomon, Jesmon acquired the trio Atho, René and Por during its training. Dianamon uses its special move Arrow of Artemis to draw and fire a long arrow of dazzling ice from the protuberance on its back. It also uses Good Night Moon to bathe its foe in moonlight fired from the Goodnight Sisters on both legs, lulling it to sleep.

Extremely loyal, it provides absolute service to its lord, who must share Dynasmon's own sense of justice. Even if others consider its master evil, Dynasmon won't hesitate to lay down its life for what it considers to be just. For this reason, it possesses a strong spirit of chivalry and bushido, and values loyalty, fidelity and courtesy above all else. Between its own draconic might and its dragon armor made of refined Chrondigizoid, it possesses matchless power. Its special moves include Dragon's Roar, with which it fires energy blasts from its palms of all the elements of the Ten Legendary Warriors, and Wyvern's Breath, with which it transforms the energy of its body into the aura of a giant wyvern.

While its personality isn't so bad, it's instigated by KingEtemon into thinking of itself as truly royal. Embarrassingly, it even believes that the Royal Knights are its subordinates. The body of this mysterious creature shines with white light, impressing all who observe its elegance. Plesiomon's special move is Sorrow Blue, which unleashes a shrill, crystal-clear vocalization that plunges its listeners into a deep sadness, sapping them of their will to fight.

metalgarurumon.description: This final form of Garurumon has been enhanced by turning most of its body into metal. Despite this process, MetalGarurumon hasn't lost any agility, and it can destroy its foes using the countless weapons hidden all over its body. The four laser sights at the tip of its nose emit invisible beams, and MetalGarurumon makes use of a wide array of sensors, including those for infrared- and X-rays, to analyze its targets. This makes it impossible to escape from MetalGarurumon, even in perfect darkness. What's more, the mechanical arms extending from MetalGarurumon's back can emit photoelectric beam wings, allowing it to fly through Net Space at incredible speed. MetalGarurumon's special move is Freezing Breath, with which it breathes out a blast of air at absolute zero that freezes everything it touches. This move instantly suspends the vital functions of any living creature it hits. It also possesses Ice Wolf Claw, which annihilates foes by unleashing every weapon in MetalGarurumon's arsenal at once.

It was remodeled to be an aquatic interceptor Digimon, completing the set of interceptor Digimon for terrestrial, marine and aerial defense. MetalSeadramon's special move is River of Power, which fires an energy blast from the cannon at the end of its nose.

medievalgallantmon.description: A Warrior Digimon extolled as the legendary hero of Witchelny, the Digital World of another dimension. Ancient Witchelny was on the path to ruin, since its magic (advanced programming language) was still in its infancy and it lacked techniques to protect the land from invasion by outside forces. It's said that MedievalGallantmon suddenly appeared and repelled invaders, and that it transcends time to exist to the present day, although the truth of this is uncertain. It fights with arms created with magic, and wields Dynas, the ultimate magic lance concealing the power of the wyvern. MedievalGallantmon is nicknamed the Whirlwind General due to its governance over the Vortex Warriors, Digimon who fight with weapons made of wind magic, one of the four magic types (fire, earth, water and wind). Practically none have seen MedievalGallantmon in the Digital World, but this Digimon is known as the Warrior of Fantasy due to its armor covered with gorgeous decoration, and is a solemn figure affixed with a coat of arms. Though somewhat overly self-conscious, Rosemon's abilities are a match for the other Megas. It wears on its chest a Tifaret, a jewel engraved with the symbols for love and beauty. It's said that those who bear this Tifaret are promised eternal beauty and strength. One of Rosemon's special moves is Thorn Whip, with which it uses a whip of thorns charged with an electric current to tame even the fiercest of Digimon. It's rumored that anyone struck by this whip becomes captivated by Rosemon, body and soul. Also, any Digimon subjected to Rosemon's Forbidden Temptation is surrounded by countless rose blossoms and has its data destroyed in a flash of beauty.

lotosmon.description: A Pixie Digimon that resembles a lotus, a flower which is said to bloom even in heaven. Lotosmon has all the dignity of a quiet and refined young lady, as well as the ability to bestow peaceful dreams upon others—visions so sweet that they're able to forget all the cares of this world. However, it's utterly merciless to those who spurn its goodwill. Using the Caduceus staff in its left hand, said to have power over both healing and harm, Lotosmon can generate either a white aura with Serpent Cure or a black aura with Serpent Ruin. It can also create a multicolored aura with the staff in its right hand, which is topped with a rainbow-colored flower. This is the special move Seven's Fantasia, with which Lotosmon saps away an enemy's will to fight by luring them into a world of pleasing visions.

avengekidmon.description: The result of a sudden transformation akin to mutation that occurred when a Digimon felled by MagnaKidmon became so obsessed with revenge that the data of its own negative thoughts overwhelmed its DigiCore. To vent its rage at taking on an appearance so similar to the Digimon it hoped to destroy, AvengeKidmon has turned to mindless rampage, to the extent that its original goal of defeating MagnaKidmon has left its thoughts. One of its special moves is Destruction Trigger, which pins an enemy underfoot before firing an explosive bullet into them at point-blank range from its gun leg, regardless of the fact that this will injure AvengeKidmon as well. The other is Misery Bullet Rain, which launches its target into the air with a stream of energy blasts from its fingers, then unleashes a barrage of live ammunition while it's still in midair.

ebemon.description: An Android Digimon artificially created from a captured Vademon that had its body's compositional data analyzed and improved. Ebemon is rumored to have been produced using extraterrestrial technology at a site known as Area 51, but the truth remains shrouded in mystery. Its special move Brain Rupture involves firing a cracking program from the gun in its left hand into its opponent's brain to absorb the data accumulated there. Planet Destroyer, by contrast, involves shooting out all the power Ebemon has amassed from the gun in its right hand. This move is said to be capable of instantaneously destroying an entire planet. Rumor has it that the country that created Ebemon is secretly researching Digimon so it can rule the Digital World.

Having unleashed the full extent of its hidden power, it yearns only for death and destruction. Myotismon, retaining its reason, intellect and refined conduct, is loath to reveal this repugnant form. VenomMyotismon's special move is Venom Infusion, which injects its opponent with a destructive virus that completely destroys its configuration data, causing it to cease functioning.

ancientwisemon.description: One of the Ten Legendary Warriors that saved the Ancient Digital World, possessing the attribute of Steel. A Mega that existed in the far-distant past, AncientWisemon is the wisest being in the Digital World. Due to the Akashic Records that chronicle the superior wisdom of ancient times, there's nothing outside of AncientWisemon's comprehension. Not only does this sage possess knowledge from time immemorial, but it also discerns events of the distant future. The mirror that comprises its body is rumored to be linked to the netherworld. AncientWisemon's abilities have been subsequently passed down to Mutant Digimon. Its special moves are Laplace's Demon, which imprisons opponents for all eternity in a netherworld located by using its vast wisdom, and Elder Sign, which summons the ultimate wicked god from a separate universe.

gaiomon.description: A subspecies of Greymon, which is an excellent combat species in its own right, Gaiomon is a Dragon Man Digimon that's grown in strength through victory in battle. Found in an abandoned computer in the East, much of its strength has yet to be quantified, but it clearly has an unbelievable amount of combat experience earned through countless battles. It was in the course of all those battles that it also gained its uniquely shaped swords, the Kikurin. A strange light trails them when they're swung, and it's said that anything that touches that light is cut to pieces. Its special move is Will-O'-Wisp Slash, with which it utilizes the light trails emanating from its Kikurin swords. It can also combine its two Kikurin swords into one, concentrating their eerie light to shoot at distant foes with Phosphorus Fire Attack.

chaosgallantmon.description: A darker side of Gallantmon, in which its nature as a Virus Digimon has come to the fore. ChaosGallantmon's mind and spirit have been thoroughly corrupted, transforming it into nothing more than a "Digital Hazard" bent on bringing destruction to the Digital World. It's clad in the same armor of nearly pure Chrondigizoid as Gallantmon—though dyed entirely black. ChaosGallantmon wields the demonic lance "Balmung" in its right hand, while bearing the demonic shield "Gorgon" in its left. In every way, it's Gallantmon's antithesis. ChaosGallantmon's special moves are Demonic Disaster, which makes a series of powerful thrusts with its demonic lance, and Judecca Prison, which releases a wave of corrosive dark energy from its demonic shield.

chaosdramon.description: Machinedramon, a Digimon made from the parts of countless cyborg Digimon, possesses unimaginable powers, and as such was apparently considered a successful experiment. Chaosdramon, with its crimson metal body, is an even more advanced version of Machinedramon. Its frame is made from Red Digizoid, a rare metal made by re-refining the virtual super-metal Chrondigizoid to increase its hardness. As a result, it's capable of repelling all manner of attacks, and destroying absolutely anything. Its special move Hyper Infinity Cannon fires super-dreadnought class energy blasts from both of its cannons.

callismon.description: A Dark Beast Digimon that resembles a bear. Although it's considered to be a Digivolution from the Grizzlymon line, it's a mutant species Digivolved from Digimon with abnormal data. It's unknown whether these data anomalies that create it are spontaneous or intentional, and since its numbers are small, its ecology and Digivolution conditions remain a mystery. Callismon's enormous arms and weapons make it highly effective in combat, and it exhibits a ferocious nature that attacks hostile opponents relentlessly until they fall. Its special moves are Deep Forest, which degrades the opponent's data by slashing with its sharp claws, and Rodeo Bullet, which fires homing shots from its three cannons.

gundramon.description: A large Digimon equipped with a veritable cache of firearms. Many Digimon refer to Gundramon as one of the "Three Musketeers," along with MagnaKidmon and BeelStarmon, due to their highly developed marksmanship. It's also a member of the Crank Team, and is suited to combat much like Machinedramon. Faster than Machinedramon, though, Gundramon has all the mobility it needs to quickly get into firing position. The acrid smell of gunpowder has soaked into every bit of its fully metallic body, as is appropriate for such a bitter and hard-boiled Digimon. Gundramon's special moves are Der Blitz, which fires at an opponent's vitals with the twin six-shooters in its hands, and Gewalt Schwärmer, which fires off a volley in all directions.

kingetemon.description: KingEtemon is a supreme being, the self-proclaimed "King of Etemon" that stands out even among its peers. It even goes so far as to refer to itself as the "King of Kings." Dressed in its dashing Monkey Suit, which prominently features the characters for "Great King" on its chest, KingEtemon struts about like a star (though other Digimon treat it as little more than a joke). KingEtemon's special move is Monkey Wrench, which puts on a performance that robs opponents of their will to fight.

grandracmon.description: A Dark Beast Digimon known as "the king of all vampire Digimon." GranDracmon has long maintained its own castle in the Dark Area, and is said to boast such immense might that not even the Seven Great Demon Lords dare meddle with it. With a well-bred demeanor and a voice laced with bewitching glamor, GranDracmon can be devilishly charming, and there are numerous tales of Angel Digimon sent to slay it that ended up being seduced to the dark side. Its special moves are Crystal Revolution, which flash-freezes all foes into ice crystals, and Eye of the Gorgon, which turns its evil gaze on the enemy, trapping its heart in darkness.

chronomon-dm.description: The form Chronomon takes when it goes berserk, Chronomon: Destroy Mode is a legendary monster that has renounced its duty of maintaining the peaceful order of space-time and has instead risen in revolt against the very time-governing system itself. While repairing space-time, all of the variformed malice existing in the Digital World flowed into Chronomon all at once, causing it to spin out of control, much as if it had been infected with a virus. Exploiting the innate temporal powers Chronomon originally possessed, Chronomon: Destroy Mode hacks into the memories etched into the Digital World and downloads a diverse arsenal of skills into itself for use in its rampages. Its special move is Finger Bomb, which forces the past data of the opponent it points at to be restored within its body, causing it to explode from the sheer volume of data. Despite its berserk state, Chronomon: Destroy Mode still has the ability to burn foes to nothing with Holy Flare. It also possesses Chrono Devolution, which converts the Digital World's time data into energy that instantly ages any who touch it, reducing their data to dust.

zanbamon.description: A Wizard Digimon resembling a mounted warrior. Zanbamon is a valiant general that leads the Musyamon Corps. Regardless of its high rank, Zanbamon is always at the head of its force, and enjoys charging directly at its foes. Its lower half has fused with its horse in order to improve mobility on the battlefield, allowing it to wield its sword without fear of losing its balance even during the harshest of battles. One of Zanbamon's special moves, Vorpal Blade, unleashes a powerful blow with the massive sword in its right hand, Ryuzan-maru. The force of this strike is so intense that it slashes through the opponent's armor no matter how it tries to defend itself. Zanbamon's other special move is Mystic Flame, an attack performed with the magical sword in its left hand. Quickly swinging this thin-bladed weapon produces a cross-shaped shockwave that slices through the enemy.

zombieplutomon.description: Plutomon's DigiCore has shut down due to reaching the end of its lifespan, but, strangely, its body is still functioning. It no longer retains its core mission of defeating evil. It thinks of nothing but devouring the data of other beings, and endlessly wanders in search of new DigiCores. Unlike when it was alive, it is now a "terrible predator" in a completely different sense, as its decaying body will never know satisfaction, no matter how many DigiCores it consumes. Its special moves include Hazard Hold, which grabs an opponent and sucks up its DigiCore data until it decays; Hell Slicer, which shoots out X particles from its left hand in order to cut the enemy to pieces; and Marionette Abomination, with which it bites enemies and infects them with a virus that turns them into a puppet forced to do its bidding.

darkdramon.description: Darkdramon is an Android Digimon believed to be the D-Brigade's ultimate weapon. Rumor has it that D-Brigade researchers created Darkdramon by Digivolving a Tankdramon they recovered. Supposedly, this Tankdramon was defeated in an operation designed to eliminate a target codenamed BAN-CHO. However, none of this information is particularly reliable. A vast amount of dark matter seems to have been used in this Digivolution process. Possibly as a result, Darkdramon immediately went berserk and fled. Its current whereabouts are unknown, even to the D-Brigade, though rumor has it that it's still searching for Codename BAN-CHO. Its special move Dark Roar is a forbidden technique that involves firing an energy bomb composed of dark matter. Nothing can survive a hit from this attack, rumor has it. Darkdramon also has a weapon called the Gigastick Lance built into its right arm, said to be equal in power to Gallantmon's holy lance Gram.

tigervespamon.description: An Android Digimon that guards the mysterious Royal Base, a secret, aerial honey base. In spite of its slender figure, TigerVespamon still boasts astounding stamina, and never stops moving in battle. The top 0.08 percent of its kind join the Covert Honey Corps: Royal Commandos, and are given codenames. TigerVespamon's codename "Tiger" comes from its excellent solo combat ability, and it uses twin blades called Royal Meister, wielding them like tiger fangs. TigerVespamon executes its special move Mach Stinger V by stabbing foes with its Royal Meister blades.

titamon.description: The counterattack titan, born from the grudge of a Digimon felled by the Olympos XII in a contest for supremacy over the Digital World. Also going by the alias "One-Man Division," Titamon harbors bottomless grudge energy within its mighty body. It runs from battlefield to battlefield, all in pursuit of the heads of the Olympos XII. Titamon's huge arms are covered in a large quantity of skulls, each formed from strength data pilfered from fallen foes. Its gigantic Zanjintou sword is carved from the bones of SkullGreymon, and the rancor dwelling within the blade emits a low growl. Titamon's special move Soul Core Attack slices straight past an enemy's armor and body, cleaving its DigiCore directly with Titamon's blade. Damage taken from a direct hit can never be healed. Phantom Blade runs a foe through with Zanjintou, plunging it into a hallucination that it remains pierced even after the blade is pulled out. The pain of this stab only subsides with the death of the enemy's spirit.

tyrantkabuterimon.description: The "Monarch of the Insects" governing all Insectoid Digimon. TyrantKabuterimon only acts at night, making a stronghold of the Under Forest deep underground below a dark forest. It can control any and all Insectoid Digimon at will, and almost never fights, itself. Its carapace is composed of high-density Chrondigizoid that can't be damaged by the average Digimon. TyrantKabuterimon uses Shine of Bee to unleash an unblockable incandescent explosion from its entire body, instantly reducing all hostiles to ash. It also uses Bee Cyclone to summon subordinate insects that form an impregnable wall of bugs.

creepymon.description: An Evil King Digimon with many Evil-species and Dark Angel Digimon under its command. Creepymon was originally an Angel Digimon, and one of quite high rank at that. However, it resorted to rebellion—or perhaps violence—against the personifications of the Digital World's goodness (which may have been the very humans who built it), and was thus deleted to the Dark Area (the graveyard of erased data). Creepymon and its ilk have vowed to one day subjugate the Digital World and exact revenge upon these personifications of goodness. It uses its special move Flame Inferno to blast enemies with superheated hellfire. Anyone hit by this attack is incinerated without a trace.

gallantmon.description: A Holy Knight Digimon and member of the Royal Knights. The Royal Knights are the highest-ranking Digimon when it comes to network security, and no Digimon has ever been able to crack their stalwart defenses. But given Gallantmon's Virus attribute, its role as one of the chief protectors of the Net inherently conflicts with its nature. This means there's always a chance, however small, that it may slip and become a threat instead. Gallantmon is clad in holy armor made of 99.9 percent pure Chrondigizoid, and it wields the holy lance "Gram" in its right hand while bearing the holy shield "Aegis" in its left. Its special moves are Lightning Joust, which unleashes a powerful thrust from Gram, and Shield of the Just, which fires a purifying beam from Aegis.

bacchusmon.description: One of the Olympos XII, this Digimon boasts that it's the heaviest drinker of the Digital World. Bacchusmon has a cheerful disposition and is well-suited to looking after others. Day or night, it always looks to gather Rookie and Champion Digimon together to throw a party. Bacchusmon has the ability to produce any form of alcohol inside its body, and if it takes a liking to another Digimon at one of these parties, it's known to offer it the drink of its choice. Bacchusmon itself has a taste for fruit wines, with its favorite variety produced from the fermented sweets of Karpos Hulē, the forest carried on Ceresmon's back. Whenever Bacchusmon has a moment to spare, it begs Ceresmon to make it some fruit wine. Because of this, the pair are on very good terms, and are often seen together. Bacchusmon's special move is Cook of the Abyss, with which it wraps its arms around a foe, alters its compositional data to a suitable finger food and then eats it. Bacchusmon also has Party of the Heavens, with which it produces a form of alcohol laced with poisons that can cause drowsiness and paralysis and then blasts enemies with the concoction to stupefy them. Furthermore, the poison data that it produces is one subject of the Crank Team's research. There are a number of credible rumors that speculate that Bacchusmon's poison data is linked to the development of bacteriological weapons and high-profile assassination plots.

bacchusmon-dm.description: One of the Olympos XII, and the self-proclaimed heartiest drinker of the Digital World. With its bright personality, Bacchusmon is good at taking care of others. At all times of the day it gathers Rookie and Champion Digimon and holds grand feasts. It can produce various types of beverages, and is happy to do so at the request of its favorite Digimon who have come to attend its feasts. Bacchusmon prefers fruit wines, and its favorite is made from fermented fruits taken from the Karpos Hulē forest on Ceresmon's back. Whenever it's free, it asks Ceresmon to let it brew that wine. As a result, the two Digimon are extremely close and often do things together. When Bacchusmon has had too much to drink, the pattern on its body turns blue, and it expels the data in its large stomach in a destructive beam of light called Reversal of the Dead. If the attack hits an opponent, Bacchusmon absorbs the data to become more powerful, so facing off against large groups of enemies can make it unfathomably strong. The data that Bacchusmon refines into poison is being researched by the Crack Team. There are plausible rumors that Bacchusmon's poison data is being used to produce biological weapons and in assassination plots against high-ranking figures.

barbamon.description: One of the Seven Great Demon Lords, this Evil King Digimon is shaped like an old man with a long beard. Barbamon exists in the heart of the den of evil known as the Dark Area, controlling Dark Angel Digimon and causing them to engage in all sorts of wickedness. It's obsessed with all the treasures of the network, using every means at its disposal to sate its greed. This rapacious and ruthless creature would kill a Digimon for even a scrap of treasure. The most cunning tactician of the Seven Deadly Digimon, it controls not only Dark Angel Digimon, but even the Mega-level Ghoulmon with ease. Barbamon's special moves are Death Lure, a demonic staff that tempts Digimon into an inescapable living hell and converts them to wickedness, and Pandemonium Lost, which releases all the evil energy of the Dark Area at once, burning everything with a super high-temperature explosion. Even MaloMyotismon's special move Pandemonium Flame releases only the smallest fraction of this energy.

piedmon.description: Piedmon is an odd-looking and elusive Wizard Digimon shrouded in mystery. Wizard Digimon are strange beings, so different from evil-species and Undead types that they may as well be from another dimension. Piedmon's true identity is unknown, as are the reasons for its sudden appearance. The very reason for its existence is a mystery, and it's currently unclear how to learn more about it. What is quite evident, however, is that it possesses incomparable power. Anyone who encounters Piedmon can do little but curse their own fate. Piedmon's special move is Trump Sword, with which it teleports the four swords stuck through the magic box on its back so that they suddenly reappear, skewering the opponent—an inescapable attack.

puppetmon.description: Puppetmon is a Mega Puppet Digimon made from the body of the dreaded Cherrymon. It's widely believed that a malicious hacker created Puppetmon from Cherrymon's data. Although Puppetmon may look like a simple marionette, it has a will of its own, and is fully capable of moving around by itself. Puppetmon is a liar with a twisted personality, and whenever a computer produces bad data, Puppetmon is usually involved somehow. Its most powerful attack is the special move Puppet Pummel, with which it loads gunpowder into its revolver-shaped hammer, then smashes foes with it. Anything hit by this attack has to bear the brunt not only of the hammer blow but also the explosion created by the gunpowder, meaning most of Puppetmon's targets are utterly destroyed.

pharaohmon.description: A Mega Wizard Digimon with a sinister golden sheen. Said to have Digivolved from a mummy-species Digimon, Pharaohmon ruled over many areas of the Ancient Digital World with absolute authority. It controlled many Digimon during the genesis of the Digital World, and the fact that Pharaohmon was able to build the mysterious ancient ruins scattered around the Digital World in a few days is proof of that dominion. It uses its special move Necromist to steal the will of hostile Digimon, then releases a fear gas that gradually dries out their flesh. Those who succumb to this attack face one of two fates: a full invitation to the world of the dead, or servitude under Pharaohmon as an undead creature.

Pukumon may be small, but its rebellious personality is second to none in the Digital World. It always picks fights, no matter how much stronger or weaker its potential opponent may be. Although Pukumon is the type to settle disputes with a slugfest, its special move Needle Squall acts as a trump card by launching all the super-hard thorns on its Chrondigizoid head at once.

From that point on, PlatinumNumemon's personality did a complete about-face as it scraped together any jewelry data it could find, decorating itself like a nouveau riche. It's quite the "gorgeous" Digimon, despite its nature. Outfitting itself with golden wings and jewelry grants it considerable defense, but its attack power is middling at best. PlatinumNumemon uses its special move Platinum Excrement to hurl the dregs(excretions) produced during the "platina" refinement process in rapid succession. It also uses Platinum Burp to release a putrid belch that saps the enemy's fighting spirit.

plutomon.description: A Digimon that rules over the realm of the dead and uses fear and violence to terrorize evil. Plutomon, shrouded in deep shadow, stalks through the land in search of villains and criminals who deserve to be sent to the realm of the dead. Plutomon delights in chewing up evildoers with its mouths filled with rows of sharp fangs, and lets out a sinister chattering noise as it seeks out its prey. The combination of this and its fearsome appearance frightens even good Digimon. Plutomon's abilities all have the disquieting power to fling villains down to the realm of the dead. In one of those moves, Hell's Gate, a giant mouth appears from the darkness and swallows enemies whole, and their data is broken down into scraps. The Haggard Cluster move has the fangs of its chest release a darkness that absorbs and vaporizes any substance in its path. Plutomon shares the goal of punishing evil with Jupitermon of the Olympos XII. However, there's a longstanding animosity between the two because Jupitermon doesn't approve of Plutomon's cruel methods.

breakdramon.description: A massive Machine Dragon Digimon said to exist to destroy all things on the face of the earth. Whenever it Digivolves, Breakdramon successfully incorporates construction equipment design data into itself through hacking, obtaining power and abilities outclassing other Machine Digimon. However, its outstanding mechanical abilities come at the cost of reducing its organic parts to a practically negligible amount, robbing it of intention and emotion. As such, Breakdramon isn't afraid of damaging its own body, and is feared as the ultimate dragon of destruction that continues to wreck havoc until it crumbles to dust. Breakdramon's Destroyed Rush spins its left and right shovel arms at high speeds to rend the earth. Its Infinity Bowling activates all of the drills on its body, unleashing them in a volley capable of smashing even mountains. Gravity Crush flattens the target with Breakdramon's entire mass, crushing any and all things. Wherever Breakdramon goes, it leaves nothing in its devastating wake.

Unlike VenomMyotismon—who pursued power in excess, becoming a bestial creature lacking intelligence—MaloMyotismon has retained its intellect, successfully surpassing VenomMyotismon in every aspect. With an atrocious and coldhearted personality, it will use any means at its disposal to satisfy its desires. The organic cannons on its shoulders are parasites known as "Sodom" and "Gomorrah." MaloMyotismon uses its special move Pandemonium Flame to launch super-high temperature beams from Sodom and Gomorrah.

These beloved Rizoma de Loto guns are like little sisters to the Berenjena, Beelzemon's signature pistols. BeelStarmon opens up to anyone without hesitation—particularly gunslinger Digimon, with friends like MagnaKidmon even using the nickname "Beelko." Still, it's on bad terms with the solitary Beelzemon, keeping its distance despite recognizing the Evil King Digimon's abilities. BeelStarmon is clad in a jet-black leather suit, and wears a scarf that can transform into weapons, armor, wings or anything else the situation warrants. Its special move is Fly Bullet, which homes in on the enemy's vitals with shots from its Rizoma de Loto.

beelzemon.description: Beelzemon is an Evil King Digimon that prizes its independence, despite having the ability to rule over many Evil-species Digimon. One of the Seven Great Demon Lords, Beelzemon is said to be capable of becoming the foremost Nightmare Soldier should it so desire, but it's also rumored that there's another Evil King Digimon whose power surpasses even Beelzemon's. Beelzemon always keeps its beloved shotguns, the Berenjena, close at hand, and it rides around on its giant motorcycle machine Behemoth. It has a cruel and ruthless personality, but due to its pride, it never appears in groups or attacks the weak. Its signature move is Darkness Claw, with which it raises its sharp claws into the air and then slices through its foe. Its special move, Double Impact, involves firing twin blasts from its two shotguns.

Because of its immense power, Belphemon's data was put into Sleep Mode by the Digital World's systems. Belphemon: Sleep Mode can't attack directly due to this deep slumber, yet its snores alone inflict damage, making this Digimon difficult to attack. Its special moves are Eternal Nightmare, which unleashes attacks through peaceful snoring, and Lampranthus, which shoots black flame from the chains coiled around its body. Eternal Nightmare is recommended for those suffering from insomnia, as everlasting slumber is practically guaranteed.

magnakidmon.description: A Dragon Man Digimon fortified with firearm contraptions all over its body. A wanderer traveling the Digital World in search of its scattered comrades, MagnaKidmon is a troublemaker that causes problems and gets caught up in incidents wherever it ends up. Its self-centered personality often makes it single-minded, but its sense of friendship and obligation runs deep. MagnaKidmon befriends any local Deputymon it comes upon, mistaking them for its brethren. This trigger-happy creature loves one-on-one combat, firing bullets indiscriminately once challenged to a duel. One of MagnaKidmon's special moves is Bind Red Trigger, which stabs the small machine guns attached to its hip-mounted magazines into the opponent, destroying it from within. Its ultimate special move is Happy Bullet Showering, which sends MagnaKidmon high into the skies with its winglike scarf to target the opponent with folded arms, pounding away at it with a mix of live ammo and plasma projectiles from its fingertips and gun muzzles on both legs.

Despite Minervamon's decidedly small frame, this incredibly strong Digimon is capable of wielding a greatsword the size of its own body. Although this Digimon is as innocent and cheerful as a young girl, its moods can fluctuate wildly. When it's in a bad mood, its behavior quickly turns upset and selfish (that is, "problematic") in a way that's out of control. Minervamon uses its special move Strike Roll to unleash a forward rolling slash from its greatsword Olympia, and Madness Merry-Go-Round to perform a horizontal spinning slash faster than the eye can see. Strike Roll can split the earth, while Madness Merry-Go-Round generates a massive tornado.

It's said to be unbeatable, but if only the reason for the fusion of this Digimon could be determined, it might serve as a clue regarding how to defeat it. Its special move, Time Unlimited, compresses time to create a pocket dimension in which it traps its foes for all eternity.

machinedramon.description: The strongest Digimon in the Digital World, with a one-hundred percent metal body. Since Machinedramon consists of a combination of parts from countless cyborg Digimon, all of the cyborg Digimon produced so far are thought to have been merely prototypes for the completion of Machinedramon. Machinedramon is strong enough to overwhelm other Digimon, and boasts incredible processing power, but as a pure Machine Digimon it lacks a will of its own. Instead, someone has implanted a program loaded with malicious intentions into its DigiCore. This malevolent DigiCore provides Machinedramon with unlimited power. Its special move Infinity Cannon fires super-dreadnought class energy blasts from both cannons.

megidramon.description: The most atrocious and evil of Dragon Digimon. Counted among the Four Great Dragons along with Azulongmon, Goldramon and Magnadramon, Megidramon's fiendish nature trumps even that of its three brethren. It's rarely encountered, to the point that its existence itself is in question. Megidramon is considered a Digital Hazard, but its power is being sealed by some unknown force. They say that awakening that power would cause the Digital World's greatest crisis. Its body is composed of Chrondigizoid. One theory states that Megidramon and ChaosGallantmon were once the same entity, and whether it appears as a dark knight or a dark dragon depends on how you observe this virtual wave of terror. Its signature move Hell Howling unleashes a powerful shockwave, while its special move Megiddo Flame turns all things to ash.

metaletemon.description: There once was a supremely strong Digimon referred to as the "King of Digimon." It sought out strong opponents, embarking on a journey of brutal encounters. Although it obtained valuable combat data, the constant battles left it with severe physical damage. It then researched its own weaknesses from the data it gained in battle, completely coated the surface of its body with Chrondigizoid metal—a substance used by metal Digimon—and was able to reinvent itself as the ultimate battle machine, MetalEtemon. Despite having maximized its combat abilities, though, it still uses a petty special move, Banana Slip, to trip up its opponent. An invincible fighter that uses both high-level combat techniques and dirty tricks has been born.

Merukimon's unrivaled speed cannot be seen with the naked eye, and so any recordings of it are said to be of its afterimages. It hates staying still and is always wandering the Digital World, making it a difficult creature to encounter. It uses its special move Thousand Fists to approach the enemy at an almost instantaneous speed before unleashing an incredible rapid-fire barrage. Merukimon is also an accomplished shaman, allowing it to use Spiritual Enchantment, cleaving the air with its beloved blade Aztec and summoning demons from another dimension.

Junomon takes its place on the battlefield as Jupitermon's loving protector, and is constantly seeking to predict, detect and root out insurgents who would defy Jupitermon's will. It has a solid grasp on all of Jupitermon's tendencies, perhaps due to its overwhelmingly affectionate nature and deep love of Jupitermon. Junomon's special moves are Needle Hive, which skewers foes with the katars on its arms, and Graceful Lance, which automatically attacks foes around it with its sentient lances.

Unceasing opposition to its beloved Jupitermon steals away the time the two of them spend together, causing Junomon to be consumed by envy. As the vitality gradually leaves its countenance, it's completely consumed by darkness instead. Eventually, Junomon reveals a new, masked face. Through this mask, Junomon perceives all Digimon around it to be evil and does everything it can to slaughter them. However, Jupitermon can't sense this form of Junomon, so it never has to face Jupitermon's judgment. Junomon: Hysteric Mode's special moves include Welcome Demise, with which it successively stabs the enemy with the lances of both arms, and Chain Lash, with which it wraps its enemy's entire body in chains and destroys it after forcing it to confess its sins.

rusttyrannomon.description: The Mega form of Tyrannomon, having Digivolved by fighting a string of intense battles from the time of the Digital World's creation. After surviving many long years in a harsh environment as MetalTyrannomon, RustTyrannomon's cyborg body has turned red with rust. In battle, it specializes in rapidly overwhelming enemy forces, and is capable of leveling an enemy base by itself. RustTyrannomon is a natural predator that hunts other Digimon, capable of consuming hundreds if not thousands of them in a short span of time. Its special moves are Terrors Cluster, with which it lowers the cannon on its back to fire a huge electromagnetic blast, and Rust Breath, which belches a streaming flame the same deep-crimson color as its body. Rust Breath also causes anything it touches to corrode. When it comes to hand-to-hand combat, RustTyrannomon overwhelms its opponents with some of the highest raw power and destructive capabilities of all Android Digimon.

leviamon.description: Fear of the excessive power in Leviamon's possession has earned it the moniker of "Devil Beast," and it's counted among the Seven Great Demon Lords. A grand creature with a maw large enough to swallow the entire Digital World, it's said to sleep in the Net Ocean near the Dark Area. If awoken, Leviamon looks down on any Digimon in positions of might, causing not only other Evil King Digimon to flee in terror, but even Angel Digimon as well. There are limits to what can be determined about this Digimon, however, and it almost never appears. It's considered a primordially evil existence that has taken up residence in the Digital World. It can use its special move Biting Crush to destroy everything in its path with its massive jaws, or Tail Strike to pulverize enemies with its long tail.

lilithmon.description: One of the Seven Great Demon Lords, this Evil King Digimon takes the form of a woman. Believed to have at one time been an Ophanimon, Lilithmon fell from grace and became what's known as the "Goddess of Darkness." Beguiling and beautiful, it seduces its foes, with certain death said to await all who accept its invitation. In keeping with its "Goddess of Darkness" moniker, Lilithmon rewards vice with generosity and virtue with cruel indignities. The fiendish "Nazar Nails" on its right hand corrode anything they touch. Lilithmon's special move is Phantom Pain, a dark breath attack that eats away at foes' bodies. Those afflicted by this curse find their data eroding, starting with their extremities, and they suffer painfully even after their inevitable demise.

It finds value in anything that leads to lasting peace, even if that means ruling through strength. LordKnightmon executes its duties with ruthless efficiency, yet shows compassion to the weak. It uses its special move Spiral Masquerade to slash its enemies with the four blades growing from its armor, or Fist of Athena to instantly draw close to the enemy before shooting a shockwave from the Pile Bunker on its right arm.

It uses its special move Mega Death to fire high-density dark matter that swallows everything into dark space. vikemon.description: A Mega Beast Man Digimon that rules over the chill arctic regions of everlasting permafrost. Vikemon's fur resembles ice crystals, and is said to be as hard as Chrondigizoid. The morning star Mjölnir that Vikemon carries on its back can shatter mountains in a single blow, distorting the atmosphere itself. It leads an army of Ikkakumon and Zudomon, and fights with all the ferocity of a demon in battle, although it's also thoughtful and compassionate to its subordinates. Vikemon uses its special move Arctic Blizzard to freeze its foes by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere to absolute zero, then shattering them with Mjölnir.

According to legend, Valkyrimon can manifest a special aura from its shining armor. This aura regenerates the data of brave warriors that fell in battle, allowing them to be reborn as Digi-Eggs. Valkyrimon also moves with incredible speed, and is capable of appearing out of nowhere like a sudden gale and cutting down foes faster than the eye can see. Its special moves include Fenrir Sword, with which it freezes foes by slashing them with its magic sword of absolute zero, which can bring all of the victim's vital functions to a halt, and Aurvandil's Arrow, with which it fires an arrow with unerring accuracy.

It's HerculesKabuterimon's greatest rival, and the two are locked in an interminable struggle. Out of the many Digimon in existence, it's one of the few with a definite purpose. Its ultimate goal is to hijack a military computer so that it can launch a nuclear strike and destroy the real world, making it a terrifying Digimon. It has been prophesied that if it can harness that power, it will demonstrate unfathomable ability and rule over Gaia. It wields the Ryuugonken, a sword with the souls of dragons sealed within, in order to control this power. Its special moves include Firedrake Strike, with which it unleashes white-hot, blazing arrows from the Ryuugonken, and Pyro Dragons, with which it releases the power of eight of the dragon veins of Gaia, taking the place of the ninth dragon itself and crushing foes with its huge sword.

Having been transformed into a sword, all of its combat ability is now channeled exclusively into offensive power. To swing the Blade of the Dragon King is to wield all the power of a Mega Digimon. craniamon-plus-enbarrmon.description: Sometimes, a select number of Royal Knights recruit local Digimon from where they are dispatched to in order to receive assistance completing their assigned mission. The methods they use to recruit these allies tend to vary by mission, but Craniamon challenges those Digimon it deems worthy to single combat and then forces them to submit. Craniamon acquired this mounted form during a mission after defeating Enbarrmon. It is believed that Craniamon, ever the perfectionist, wished to utilize Enbarrmon as a steed in order to complete its missions more efficiently. Despite many fierce battles between them, their mutual recognition of each other's strength has created a strong sense of trust, resulting in remarkable mobility and attack power. Their special move Ruthless Charge features Enbarrmon galloping at full speed while Craniamon performs a thrusting attack with its magic lance Claíomh Solais. Given the speed of Enbarrmon's charge and their combined mass, together with Craniamon's brute strength, most Digimon caught in their path are scattered like leaves. Additionally, the blessing of undying protection that Enbarrmon grants its riders also applies to Craniamon's shield, Avalon, allowing it to use Breath of the Gods without the usual three-second limitation, meaning it can nullify attacks indefinitely.

All details of that time are shrouded in mystery. Continued research into Digimon and the Digital World should eventually shed light on the subject. The cloak on its back deploys automatically when it needs to avoid enemy attacks or to fly. Omnimon's special move is Supreme Cannon, fired from the MetalGarurumon-shaped cannon on its right arm. Susanomon's special moves are Ama no Habakiri, which cleaves anything and everything under heaven with the blade of light released from its ZERO-ARMS: Orochi, and Yakusa no Ikazuchi, the ultimate technique by which it points its ZERO-ARMS: Orochi blade of light toward the heavens, transforming the blade into destructive lightning that then rains down upon the world.

Its rage is made evident by the violent lightning that surrounds it, yet the efficient calm of its movements exerts an incredible pressure upon its enemy. Jupitermon: Wrath Mode's special move Lightning Beam summons lightning to strike where it points its finger. It can also call upon the heavens to cast judgment on its defeated enemy with Dios Thunder. If the attack hits, the enemy is judged as guilty, and if it misses, they're not guilty. It has massive, sentient wings referred to as "Caledfwlch," along with a giant lance called "Ambrose." Examon's special move Pendragon's Glory unleashes a powerful laser beam from Ambrose. titamon-plus-skullbaluchimon.description: SkullBaluchimon, thought to be without emotion, overpowered and made tame by Titamon. Compensating for the mobility that was Titamon's sole weakness, SkullBaluchimon (Titamon Riding) resembles nothing short of a fierce deity as it races freely about the battlefield. Normally, the black chill emanating from SkullBaluchimon's DigiCore instills the fear of death in all who touch it, rendering them powerless. Titamon, however, used its unyielding mental fortitude to absorb SkullBaluchimon's dark cold and add it to its own strength. In addition, SkullBaluchimon's data fused with Titamon's Zanjintou sword, transforming it from a long sword into a huge, double-bladed polearm. The grudge data billowing from Zanjintou was also further strengthened by the black chill of SkullBaluchimon's DigiCore, causing any foes struck by it to suffer physical and mental wounds that never heal. SkullBaluchimon (Titamon Riding) uses its special move Senjin Kishinzan to spin its polearm-form Zanjintou around and around, mincing the DigiCores of its foes into tiny particles.

Gallantmon: Crimson Mode's chest contains a DigiCore with a Digital Hazard sealed within it that causes wings of energy to radiate from its back when it releases the power in its body. It wields the lance of light Gungnir and the sword of light Blutgang, which are energy weapons without form. Its special move Invincible Sword cleaves the enemy with Blutgang, and Quo Vadis tears apart foes on an atomic level with Gungnir before consigning them to another dimension.

It's said that none can stand against a Beelzemon once it has reached this form. Its right arm has fused with a blaster, allowing it to fire monstrous energy waves that disintegrate anything they touch. Beelzemon: Blast Mode uses its signature move Death Slinger to fire a destructive wave from its right arm, and its special move Chaos Flare to draw a magic circle, through which it fires its destructive wave.

belphemon-rm.description: Belphemon awakes from its constant slumber once every thousand years and returns to its original form. It transforms into an avatar of rage once awakened, and everything in its field of vision is subject to destruction. Digimon of Ultimate level or lower who hear Belphemon: Rage Mode's roar face instant death from data fragmentation, and not even Mega Digimon can escape unharmed. It uses its special move Lampranthus to shoot black flames from the chains coiled around its body, and Gift of Darkness to cleave with claws enveloped in infernal flames. Also, the data of Digimon killed by that which rules over the Seven Great Demon Lords isn't reincarnated, going instead to the Dark Area to act as flesh and blood for Evil Kings.

mervamon.description: A Deity Digimon and member of the Olympos XII that resembles a woman. Mervamon is the form of Minervamon that has amassed experience and achievements over time, and it has a much calmer and more mature personality compared to its previous form. It has come to pursue elegance and charm—observed in abundance in both its mannerisms and conduct—and exudes sensuality into its surroundings. It even seeks charm in battle, performing a refined, graceful dance to fascinate those who behold it. That's why more than a few Digimon become fans of Mervamon upon observing this dance. The Love Poison sprayed from the mouth of the Medullia on its left arm bewitches any who inhale it, letting Mervamon wring the life out of them. Madness Merry-Go-Round DX is a spinning slash, with its greatsword Olympia Kai and Medullia creating a tornado that instantly tears any foe it touches to shreds.
